table billing.access_cutover_approvals
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column entitlement text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
  column change text NOT NULL
  column approved_by text NOT NULL
  column approved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint access_cutover_approvals_approved_by_check CHECK (((octet_length(approved_by) >= 1) AND (octet_length(approved_by) <= 255)))
  constraint access_cutover_approvals_change_check CHECK ((change = ANY (ARRAY['lost'::text, 'gained'::text])))
  constraint access_cutover_approvals_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint access_cutover_approvals_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint access_cutover_approvals_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX access_cutover_approvals_key ON billing.access_cutover_approvals USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, entitlement, change)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX access_cutover_approvals_pkey ON billing.access_cutover_approvals USING btree (merchant_id, id)

table billing.account_updater_batches
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column custodian_id uuid NOT NULL
  column job_ref text
  column status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text
  column instruments jsonb NOT NULL
  column result_counts jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column failure_reason text
  column submitted_at timestamp with time zone
  column last_polled_at timestamp with time zone
  column completed_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint account_updater_batches_custodian_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, custodian_id) REFERENCES billing.custodians(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint account_updater_batches_failure_reason_check CHECK ((failure_reason <> ''::text))
  constraint account_updater_batches_job_ref_check CHECK ((btrim(job_ref) <> ''::text))
  constraint account_updater_batches_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint account_updater_batches_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint account_updater_batches_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'submitted'::text, 'completed'::text, 'failed'::text])))
  constraint account_updater_batches_submitted_has_job_check CHECK (((status <> 'submitted'::text) OR (job_ref IS NOT NULL)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_updater_batches_custodian_id_job_ref_key ON billing.account_updater_batches USING btree (merchant_id, custodian_id, job_ref) WHERE (job_ref IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_updater_batches_custodian_id_key ON billing.account_updater_batches USING btree (merchant_id, custodian_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'submitted'::text]))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_updater_batches_pkey ON billing.account_updater_batches USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX account_updater_batches_status_created_at_idx ON billing.account_updater_batches USING btree (merchant_id, status, created_at)

table billing.admission_denials_hourly
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column denial_reason text NOT NULL
  column hour_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column denials bigint NOT NULL
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint admission_denials_hourly_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint admission_denials_hourly_denials_positive_check CHECK ((denials > 0))
  constraint admission_denials_hourly_hour_aligned_check CHECK ((hour_at = date_trunc('hour'::text, hour_at)))
  constraint admission_denials_hourly_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint admission_denials_hourly_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, denial_reason, hour_at)
  index CREATE INDEX admission_denials_hourly_hour_at_idx ON billing.admission_denials_hourly USING btree (merchant_id, hour_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admission_denials_hourly_pkey ON billing.admission_denials_hourly USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, denial_reason, hour_at)

table billing.admission_operations PARTITION BY RANGE (admitted_at)
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column request_id text NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column estimated_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column available_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column terms jsonb NOT NULL
  column requested_expires_at timestamp with time zone
  column expires_at timestamp with time zone
  column admitted_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column window_keys text[] NOT NULL
  column state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'::text
  column capture_terms jsonb
  column captured_amount bigint
  column captured_at timestamp with time zone
  column released_at timestamp with time zone
  column estimate_usage jsonb
  column rate_cards jsonb
  constraint admission_operations_available_amount_check CHECK ((available_amount >= 0))
  constraint admission_operations_capture_terms_check CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(capture_terms) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((capture_terms)::text) <= 65536)))
  constraint admission_operations_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint admission_operations_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint admission_operations_estimate_usage_check CHECK ((((estimate_usage IS NULL) = (rate_cards IS NULL)) AND ((estimate_usage IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(estimate_usage) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((estimate_usage)::text) <= 65536))) AND ((rate_cards IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(rate_cards) = 'array'::text) AND (octet_length((rate_cards)::text) <= 262144)))))
  constraint admission_operations_estimated_amount_check CHECK ((estimated_amount >= 0))
  constraint admission_operations_expires_at_check CHECK (((requested_expires_at IS NULL) OR ((expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at >= requested_expires_at))))
  constraint admission_operations_hold_lifetime_check CHECK (((expires_at IS NULL) OR (expires_at <= (admitted_at + '720:00:00'::interval))))
  constraint admission_operations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, request_id, admitted_at)
  constraint admission_operations_request_id_check CHECK (((octet_length(request_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(request_id) <= 255)))
  constraint admission_operations_requested_expires_at_check CHECK (((estimated_amount = 0) OR ((requested_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (requested_expires_at > admitted_at))))
  constraint admission_operations_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'released'::text, 'captured'::text])))
  constraint admission_operations_state_fields_check CHECK ((((state = 'open'::text) AND (capture_terms IS NULL) AND (captured_amount IS NULL) AND (captured_at IS NULL) AND (released_at IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'released'::text) AND (capture_terms IS NULL) AND (captured_amount IS NULL) AND (captured_at IS NULL) AND (released_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state = 'captured'::text) AND (capture_terms IS NOT NULL) AND (captured_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (captured_amount >= 0) AND (captured_at IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint admission_operations_terms_check CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(terms) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((terms)::text) <= 65536)))
  index CREATE INDEX admission_operations_admitted_at_request_id_idx ON ONLY billing.admission_operations USING btree (merchant_id, admitted_at DESC, request_id COLLATE "C" DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX admission_operations_customer_admitted_at_request_id_idx ON ONLY billing.admission_operations USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, admitted_at DESC, request_id COLLATE "C" DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX admission_operations_customer_id_currency_admitted_at_idx ON ONLY billing.admission_operations USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, admitted_at) WHERE (state <> 'released'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX admission_operations_customer_id_currency_expires_at_idx ON ONLY billing.admission_operations USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, expires_at) WHERE (state = 'open'::text)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admission_operations_pkey ON ONLY billing.admission_operations USING btree (merchant_id, request_id, admitted_at)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_admission_operation_facts BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.admission_operations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_billing_fact_columns('expires_at', 'state', 'capture_terms', 'captured_amount', 'captured_at', 'released_at')

table billing.balance_watches
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column next_check_at timestamp with time zone
  column depletes_at timestamp with time zone
  column low_notified_at timestamp with time zone
  column depleted_at timestamp with time zone
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column funded_at timestamp with time zone
  column usage_rate_per_hour bigint NOT NULL
  column rate_sampled_at timestamp with time zone
  constraint balance_watches_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint balance_watches_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint balance_watches_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint balance_watches_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency)
  constraint balance_watches_usage_rate_per_hour_check CHECK ((usage_rate_per_hour >= 0))
  index CREATE INDEX balance_watches_depletes_at_idx ON billing.balance_watches USING btree (merchant_id, depletes_at)
  index CREATE INDEX balance_watches_next_check_at_idx ON billing.balance_watches USING btree (next_check_at, merchant_id, customer_id, currency) WHERE (next_check_at IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX balance_watches_pkey ON billing.balance_watches USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency)

table billing.catalog_applications
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column application_id text NOT NULL
  column schema_version bigint NOT NULL
  column request_sha256 bytea NOT NULL
  column base_revision bigint NOT NULL
  column applied_revision bigint NOT NULL
  column result jsonb NOT NULL
  column applied_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint catalog_applications_application_id_check CHECK (((length(application_id) >= 1) AND (length(application_id) <= 128)))
  constraint catalog_applications_applied_revision_check CHECK ((applied_revision = (base_revision + 1)))
  constraint catalog_applications_base_revision_check CHECK ((base_revision >= 0))
  constraint catalog_applications_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint catalog_applications_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, application_id)
  constraint catalog_applications_request_sha256_check CHECK ((octet_length(request_sha256) = 32))
  constraint catalog_applications_result_check CHECK ((octet_length((result)::text) <= 16384))
  index CREATE INDEX catalog_applications_merchant_hash_idx ON billing.catalog_applications USING btree (merchant_id, request_sha256, applied_revision DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_applications_pkey ON billing.catalog_applications USING btree (merchant_id, application_id)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_catalog_application_receipt BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.catalog_applications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_catalog_application_receipt()

table billing.catalog_field_owners
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column object text NOT NULL
  column key text NOT NULL
  column price_key text NOT NULL
  column field text NOT NULL
  column manager text NOT NULL
  column actor text NOT NULL
  column set_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  constraint catalog_field_owners_actor_check CHECK (((actor <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(actor) <= 255)))
  constraint catalog_field_owners_field_check CHECK ((((object = 'product'::text) AND (field = ANY (ARRAY['display_name'::text, 'description'::text, 'tier_group'::text, 'tier_rank'::text, 'archived'::text, 'ownership'::text, 'entitlements'::text, 'required_entitlements'::text, 'credit_grant'::text, 'rate_cards'::text]))) OR ((object = 'price'::text) AND (field = ANY (ARRAY['currency'::text, 'unit_amount'::text, 'access_duration_hours'::text, 'billing_interval_hours'::text, 'billing_interval_months'::text, 'provider_access_default'::text, 'trial_unit_amount'::text, 'trial_duration_hours'::text, 'customer_amount'::text, 'quantity'::text, 'archived'::text, 'sell_via'::text, 'provider'::text]))) OR ((object = 'meter'::text) AND (field = ANY (ARRAY['event_type'::text, 'value_property'::text, 'aggregation'::text, 'unit'::text, 'group_by'::text])))))
  constraint catalog_field_owners_key_check CHECK (((key <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(key) <= 255)))
  constraint catalog_field_owners_manager_check CHECK ((manager = ANY (ARRAY['apply'::text, 'edit'::text])))
  constraint catalog_field_owners_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint catalog_field_owners_object_check CHECK ((object = ANY (ARRAY['product'::text, 'price'::text, 'meter'::text])))
  constraint catalog_field_owners_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, object, key, price_key, field, manager)
  constraint catalog_field_owners_price_key_check CHECK ((((object = 'price'::text) = (price_key <> ''::text)) AND (octet_length(price_key) <= 255)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_field_owners_pkey ON billing.catalog_field_owners USING btree (merchant_id, object, key, price_key, field, manager)

table billing.catalog_meters
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column key text NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column event_type text
  column value_property text
  column aggregation text
  column unit text
  column group_by jsonb NOT NULL
  column revision bigint NOT NULL
  constraint catalog_meters_aggregation_check CHECK (((aggregation IS NULL) OR (aggregation = ANY (ARRAY['sum'::text, 'count'::text, 'max'::text, 'min'::text, 'unique_count'::text, 'latest'::text]))))
  constraint catalog_meters_key_nonempty_check CHECK ((btrim(key) <> ''::text))
  constraint catalog_meters_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint catalog_meters_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, key)
  constraint catalog_meters_revision_check CHECK ((revision >= 1))
  index CREATE INDEX catalog_meters_event_type_idx ON billing.catalog_meters USING btree (merchant_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(event_type, ''::text), key))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_meters_pkey ON billing.catalog_meters USING btree (merchant_id, key)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authored_meter BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.catalog_meters FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_authored_write()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_meter_revision BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON billing.catalog_meters FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.assign_object_revision()

table billing.catalog_rate_cards
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column product_id uuid NOT NULL
  column ordinal integer NOT NULL
  column meter_key text
  column payment_term text
  column filter jsonb NOT NULL
  column allowance jsonb

  constraint catalog_rate_cards_ordinal_positive_check CHECK ((ordinal >= 1))
  constraint catalog_rate_cards_payment_term_check CHECK ((payment_term = ANY (ARRAY['in_advance'::text, 'in_arrears'::text])))
  constraint catalog_rate_cards_payment_term_metered_check CHECK (((meter_key IS NULL) = (payment_term IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint catalog_rate_cards_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint catalog_rate_cards_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, product_id) REFERENCES billing.products(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_rate_cards_pkey ON billing.catalog_rate_cards USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_rate_cards_product_id_ordinal_key ON billing.catalog_rate_cards USING btree (merchant_id, product_id, ordinal)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authored_rate_card BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.catalog_rate_cards FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_authored_write()

table billing.custodians

  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column key text NOT NULL
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column environment text NOT NULL
  column account_id text NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint custodians_environment_check CHECK ((environment = ANY (ARRAY['live'::text, 'test'::text])))
  constraint custodians_id_kind_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, id, kind)
  constraint custodians_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['basis_theory'::text, 'hyperswitch'::text, 'platform'::text])))
  constraint custodians_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint custodians_nonempty_check CHECK (((btrim(key) <> ''::text) AND (btrim(account_id) <> ''::text)))
  constraint custodians_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX custodians_id_kind_key ON billing.custodians USING btree (merchant_id, id, kind)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX custodians_key_key ON billing.custodians USING btree (merchant_id, lower(key))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX custodians_kind_environment_account_id_key ON billing.custodians USING btree (kind, environment, account_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX custodians_pkey ON billing.custodians USING btree (merchant_id, id)

table billing.custody_migrations
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column batch_id uuid NOT NULL
  column payment_method_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column from_custodian text NOT NULL
  column from_custodian_id uuid
  column from_rail_customer_ref text
  column from_rail_method_ref text
  column from_psp_id uuid
  column to_custodian text NOT NULL
  column to_custodian_id uuid NOT NULL
  column to_rail_method_ref text NOT NULL
  column to_psp_id uuid
  column exported_at timestamp with time zone
  column outcome text NOT NULL
  column reason text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint custody_migrations_from_custodian_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, from_custodian_id) REFERENCES billing.custodians(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint custody_migrations_from_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, from_psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint custody_migrations_from_rail_customer_ref_check CHECK ((from_rail_customer_ref <> ''::text))
  constraint custody_migrations_from_rail_method_ref_check CHECK ((from_rail_method_ref <> ''::text))
  constraint custody_migrations_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint custody_migrations_outcome_check CHECK ((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['remapped'::text, 'created'::text])))
  constraint custody_migrations_payment_method_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, payment_method_id) REFERENCES billing.payment_methods(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint custody_migrations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint custody_migrations_reason_check CHECK ((reason <> ''::text))
  constraint custody_migrations_target_check CHECK (((btrim(to_rail_method_ref) <> ''::text) AND (btrim(to_custodian) <> ''::text)))
  constraint custody_migrations_to_custodian_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, to_custodian_id) REFERENCES billing.custodians(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint custody_migrations_to_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, to_psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  index CREATE INDEX custody_migrations_batch_id_created_at_idx ON billing.custody_migrations USING btree (merchant_id, batch_id, created_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX custody_migrations_payment_method_id_to_rail_method_ref_key ON billing.custody_migrations USING btree (merchant_id, payment_method_id, to_rail_method_ref)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX custody_migrations_pkey ON billing.custody_migrations USING btree (merchant_id, id)

table billing.customer_contacts
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column email text
  column display_name text
  column user_name text
  column active boolean
  column provisioned_at timestamp with time zone
  column directory_updated_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint customer_contacts_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint customer_contacts_display_name_check CHECK (((display_name IS NULL) OR ((display_name = btrim(display_name)) AND (display_name <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(display_name) <= 256))))
  constraint customer_contacts_email_check CHECK (((email IS NULL) OR ((email = btrim(email)) AND (email <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(email) <= 320))))
  constraint customer_contacts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, customer_id)
  constraint customer_contacts_user_name_check CHECK (((user_name IS NULL) OR ((user_name = btrim(user_name)) AND (user_name <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(user_name) <= 256))))
  index CREATE INDEX customer_contacts_email_idx ON billing.customer_contacts USING btree (merchant_id, lower(email)) WHERE (email IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_contacts_pkey ON billing.customer_contacts USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id)
  index CREATE INDEX customer_contacts_provisioned_idx ON billing.customer_contacts USING btree (merchant_id, provisioned_at, customer_id) WHERE (provisioned_at IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_contacts_user_name_key ON billing.customer_contacts USING btree (merchant_id, lower(user_name)) WHERE (provisioned_at IS NOT NULL)

table billing.customer_delinquency
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column state text NOT NULL
  column overdue_started_at timestamp with time zone
  column entered_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column overdue_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column overdue_orders bigint NOT NULL
  column transition_seq bigint NOT NULL
  column evaluated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint customer_delinquency_amount_check CHECK (((overdue_amount >= 0) AND (overdue_orders >= 0)))
  constraint customer_delinquency_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint customer_delinquency_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint customer_delinquency_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint customer_delinquency_overdue_started_at_check CHECK ((((state = 'current'::text) AND (overdue_started_at IS NULL)) OR ((state <> 'current'::text) AND (overdue_started_at IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint customer_delinquency_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency)
  constraint customer_delinquency_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['current'::text, 'grace'::text, 'delinquent'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX customer_delinquency_customer_id_currency_idx ON billing.customer_delinquency USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency) WHERE (state <> 'current'::text)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_delinquency_pkey ON billing.customer_delinquency USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency)

table billing.customer_entitlement_cache_stamps
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column entitlement_generation bigint NOT NULL
  column access_version bigint NOT NULL
  column valid_from timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column valid_until timestamp with time zone
  column keys integer NOT NULL
  column held_products integer NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint customer_entitlement_cache_stamps_counts_check CHECK (((keys >= 0) AND (held_products >= 0)))
  constraint customer_entitlement_cache_stamps_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint customer_entitlement_cache_stamps_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint customer_entitlement_cache_stamps_window_check CHECK (((valid_until IS NULL) OR (valid_from < valid_until)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_entitlement_cache_stamps_customer_key ON billing.customer_entitlement_cache_stamps USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_entitlement_cache_stamps_pkey ON billing.customer_entitlement_cache_stamps USING btree (merchant_id, id)

table billing.customer_links
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column account_id uuid NOT NULL
  column method text NOT NULL
  column credential text
  column order_id uuid
  column auth_time timestamp with time zone
  column amr text[]
  column terms_version text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column linked_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column revoked_at timestamp with time zone
  column revoked_by text
  constraint customer_links_customer_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint customer_links_method_check CHECK ((method = ANY (ARRAY['payment_page'::text, 'connect'::text, 'sign_in'::text])))
  constraint customer_links_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint customer_links_proof_check CHECK ((((method = 'payment_page'::text) AND (credential = 'pay_url'::text) AND (order_id IS NOT NULL) AND (auth_time IS NOT NULL) AND (amr IS NOT NULL)) OR ((method = 'connect'::text) AND (credential = 'customer_token'::text) AND (order_id IS NULL) AND (auth_time IS NOT NULL) AND (amr IS NOT NULL)) OR ((method = 'sign_in'::text) AND (credential IS NULL) AND (order_id IS NULL) AND (auth_time IS NULL) AND (amr IS NULL) AND (customer_id = account_id))))
  constraint customer_links_revocation_check CHECK ((((status = 'revoked'::text) = (revoked_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((revoked_at IS NULL) = (revoked_by IS NULL)) AND ((revoked_at IS NULL) OR (revoked_at >= linked_at))))
  constraint customer_links_revoked_by_check CHECK ((revoked_by = ANY (ARRAY['customer'::text, 'account_deleted'::text, 'merchant_left'::text])))
  constraint customer_links_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'revoked'::text])))
  constraint customer_links_terms_version_check CHECK (((terms_version = btrim(terms_version)) AND (terms_version <> ''::text)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_links_account_active_key ON billing.customer_links USING btree (account_id, merchant_id) WHERE (status = 'active'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX customer_links_account_idx ON billing.customer_links USING btree (account_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_links_customer_active_key ON billing.customer_links USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id) WHERE (status = 'active'::text)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_links_pkey ON billing.customer_links USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX customer_links_revoked_at_idx ON billing.customer_links USING btree (merchant_id, revoked_at) WHERE (status = 'revoked'::text)

table billing.customer_low_balance_lines
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column amount bigint
  column runway_hours integer
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint customer_low_balance_lines_amount_check CHECK ((amount >= 0))
  constraint customer_low_balance_lines_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint customer_low_balance_lines_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint customer_low_balance_lines_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency)
  constraint customer_low_balance_lines_runway_hours_check CHECK (((runway_hours >= 0) AND (runway_hours <= 8760)))
  constraint customer_low_balance_lines_set_check CHECK (((amount IS NOT NULL) OR (runway_hours IS NOT NULL)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_low_balance_lines_pkey ON billing.customer_low_balance_lines USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency)

table billing.customers
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column issuer text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column last_seen_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column access_version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column billing_policy text
  constraint customers_billing_policy_check CHECK ((billing_policy <> ''::text))
  constraint customers_issuer_check CHECK (((issuer IS NULL) OR ((issuer = btrim(issuer)) AND (issuer <> ''::text))))
  constraint customers_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint customers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX customers_billing_policy_idx ON billing.customers USING btree (merchant_id, billing_policy) WHERE (billing_policy IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX customers_id_idx ON billing.customers USING btree (id, merchant_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_pkey ON billing.customers USING btree (merchant_id, id)

table billing.dashboard_configs

  constraint dashboard_configs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dashboard_configs_pkey ON billing.dashboard_configs USING btree (merchant_id)

table billing.destructive_action_switch
  column singleton boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  column enabled boolean NOT NULL
  column updated_by text
  column reason text
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint destructive_action_switch_pkey PRIMARY KEY (singleton)
  constraint destructive_action_switch_singleton_check CHECK ((singleton = true))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX destructive_action_switch_pkey ON billing.destructive_action_switch USING btree (singleton)

table billing.destructive_actions
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column admission_sequence bigint NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column target text NOT NULL
  column action_key text NOT NULL
  column request_digest text NOT NULL
  column origin text NOT NULL
  column actor_issuer text NOT NULL
  column actor_id text NOT NULL
  column actor_key text NOT NULL
  column credential text
  column units bigint NOT NULL
  column admitted_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column state text NOT NULL
  column started_at timestamp with time zone
  column finished_at timestamp with time zone
  column completion_sequence bigint
  column result text
  constraint destructive_actions_action_key_check CHECK (((btrim(action_key) <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(action_key) <= 2048)))
  constraint destructive_actions_actor_id_check CHECK ((btrim(actor_id) <> ''::text))
  constraint destructive_actions_actor_issuer_check CHECK ((btrim(actor_issuer) <> ''::text))
  constraint destructive_actions_actor_key_check CHECK ((actor_key ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
  constraint destructive_actions_admission_sequence_key UNIQUE (admission_sequence)
  constraint destructive_actions_credential_check CHECK ((credential <> ''::text))
  constraint destructive_actions_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['refund'::text, 'cancel_subscription'::text, 'delete_payment_method'::text, 'revoke_credit'::text, 'revoke_access'::text, 'waive_order'::text, 'mark_uncollectible'::text, 'catalog_change'::text, 'configuration_change'::text])))
  constraint destructive_actions_lifecycle_check CHECK ((((state = 'reserved'::text) AND (started_at IS NULL) AND (finished_at IS NULL)) OR ((state = ANY (ARRAY['started'::text, 'uncertain'::text])) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (finished_at IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'succeeded'::text) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completion_sequence IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state = 'no_effect'::text) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint destructive_actions_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint destructive_actions_origin_check CHECK ((origin = ANY (ARRAY['staff'::text, 'host'::text, 'automation'::text])))
  constraint destructive_actions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint destructive_actions_request_digest_check CHECK ((request_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
  constraint destructive_actions_result_check CHECK (((result <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(result) <= 2048)))
  constraint destructive_actions_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'started'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'no_effect'::text, 'uncertain'::text])))
  constraint destructive_actions_target_check CHECK (((btrim(target) <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(target) <= 2048)))
  constraint destructive_actions_units_check CHECK (((units > 0) AND (units <= 1000000000)))
  index CREATE INDEX destructive_actions_actor_recent_idx ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (actor_key, GREATEST(admitted_at, finished_at)) INCLUDE (units) WHERE ((state = 'succeeded'::text) AND (origin = 'staff'::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX destructive_actions_admission_sequence_key ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (admission_sequence)
  index CREATE INDEX destructive_actions_completion_sequence_idx ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (completion_sequence) WHERE (completion_sequence IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX destructive_actions_key_history_idx ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (merchant_id, action_key, admitted_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX destructive_actions_live_key ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (merchant_id, action_key) WHERE (state <> 'no_effect'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX destructive_actions_merchant_recent_idx ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (merchant_id, origin, GREATEST(admitted_at, finished_at)) INCLUDE (units) WHERE (state = 'succeeded'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX destructive_actions_pending_idx ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (merchant_id, actor_key) INCLUDE (units) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'started'::text, 'uncertain'::text]))
  index CREATE INDEX destructive_actions_pending_target_idx ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (merchant_id, target, actor_issuer, actor_id, request_digest) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'started'::text, 'uncertain'::text]))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX destructive_actions_pkey ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX destructive_actions_recent_idx ON billing.destructive_actions USING btree (GREATEST(admitted_at, finished_at)) INCLUDE (units) WHERE ((state = 'succeeded'::text) AND (origin = 'staff'::text))
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER destructive_actions_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.destructive_actions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_billing_fact_columns('state', 'started_at', 'finished_at', 'completion_sequence', 'result')
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER destructive_actions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON billing.destructive_actions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER destructive_actions_state BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.destructive_actions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_destructive_action_state()

table billing.destructive_holds
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column scope text NOT NULL
  column scope_key text NOT NULL
  column actor_issuer text NOT NULL
  column actor_id text NOT NULL
  column credential text
  column action_kind text NOT NULL
  column target text NOT NULL
  column window_name text NOT NULL
  column observed bigint NOT NULL
  column requested bigint NOT NULL
  column ceiling bigint NOT NULL
  column opened_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column cleared_at timestamp with time zone
  column clear_through_sequence bigint
  column cleared_by_issuer text
  column cleared_by_id text
  column clear_reason text
  constraint destructive_holds_actor_id_check CHECK ((btrim(actor_id) <> ''::text))
  constraint destructive_holds_actor_issuer_check CHECK ((btrim(actor_issuer) <> ''::text))
  constraint destructive_holds_ceiling_check CHECK ((ceiling > 0))
  constraint destructive_holds_clear_check CHECK ((((cleared_at IS NULL) AND (clear_through_sequence IS NULL) AND (cleared_by_issuer IS NULL) AND (cleared_by_id IS NULL) AND (clear_reason IS NULL)) OR ((cleared_at IS NOT NULL) AND (clear_through_sequence IS NOT NULL) AND (clear_through_sequence >= 0) AND (cleared_by_issuer IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(cleared_by_issuer) <> ''::text) AND (cleared_by_id IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(cleared_by_id) <> ''::text) AND (clear_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(clear_reason) <> ''::text) AND ((cleared_by_issuer IS DISTINCT FROM actor_issuer) OR (cleared_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM actor_id)))))
  constraint destructive_holds_credential_check CHECK ((credential <> ''::text))
  constraint destructive_holds_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint destructive_holds_observed_check CHECK ((observed >= 0))
  constraint destructive_holds_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint destructive_holds_requested_check CHECK ((requested > 0))
  constraint destructive_holds_scope_check CHECK ((scope = ANY (ARRAY['actor'::text, 'merchant'::text, 'deployment'::text])))
  constraint destructive_holds_scope_key_check CHECK ((btrim(scope_key) <> ''::text))
  constraint destructive_holds_target_check CHECK ((btrim(target) <> ''::text))
  constraint destructive_holds_window_name_check CHECK ((window_name = ANY (ARRAY['hour'::text, 'day'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX destructive_holds_epoch_idx ON billing.destructive_holds USING btree (scope_key, cleared_at DESC) WHERE (cleared_at IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX destructive_holds_merchant_idx ON billing.destructive_holds USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX destructive_holds_open_scope_key ON billing.destructive_holds USING btree (scope_key) WHERE (cleared_at IS NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX destructive_holds_pkey ON billing.destructive_holds USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER destructive_holds_clear BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.destructive_holds FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_destructive_hold_clear()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER destructive_holds_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.destructive_holds FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_billing_fact_columns('cleared_at', 'clear_through_sequence', 'cleared_by_issuer', 'cleared_by_id', 'clear_reason')
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER destructive_holds_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON billing.destructive_holds FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()

table billing.destructive_run_before_images
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column destructive_run_id uuid NOT NULL
  column table_name text NOT NULL
  column row_id uuid NOT NULL
  column before jsonb NOT NULL
  column captured_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column restored_at timestamp with time zone
  column destructive_run_class text NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('destructive'::text) STORED
  column after_lifecycle_rev bigint
  constraint destructive_run_before_images_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint destructive_run_before_images_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint destructive_run_before_images_run_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, destructive_run_id, destructive_run_class) REFERENCES billing.maintenance_runs(merchant_id, id, run_class) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint destructive_run_before_images_table_check CHECK ((table_name = ANY (ARRAY['subscriptions'::text, 'entitlements'::text, 'product_access'::text])))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX destructive_run_before_images_identity_key ON billing.destructive_run_before_images USING btree (merchant_id, destructive_run_id, table_name, row_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX destructive_run_before_images_pkey ON billing.destructive_run_before_images USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_destructive_before_images BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.destructive_run_before_images FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_before_image()

table billing.failed_usage_windows
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column invoker text NOT NULL
  column window_key text NOT NULL
  column window_start timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column window_end timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  constraint failed_usage_windows_amount_check CHECK ((amount > 0))
  constraint failed_usage_windows_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint failed_usage_windows_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint failed_usage_windows_invoker_check CHECK ((octet_length(invoker) <= 255))
  constraint failed_usage_windows_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint failed_usage_windows_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, invoker, window_key, window_start)
  constraint failed_usage_windows_window_check CHECK ((window_end > window_start))
  constraint failed_usage_windows_window_key_check CHECK (((window_key <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(window_key) <= 255)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX failed_usage_windows_pkey ON billing.failed_usage_windows USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, invoker, window_key, window_start)
  index CREATE INDEX failed_usage_windows_window_end_idx ON billing.failed_usage_windows USING btree (merchant_id, window_end)

table billing.grants
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column product_id uuid
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column source_type text NOT NULL
  column source_id text
  column payment_id uuid
  column event text NOT NULL
  column supersedes_id uuid
  column spec_snapshot jsonb
  column starts_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column ends_at timestamp with time zone
  column amount bigint
  column currency text
  column reason text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column actor text
  column grant_reason text
  column quantity integer
  constraint grants_access_grant_reason_check CHECK (((NOT ((kind = 'access'::text) AND (source_type = 'grant'::text) AND (event = 'grant'::text))) OR ((grant_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (actor IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint grants_access_product_check CHECK (((kind <> 'access'::text) OR ((product_id IS NOT NULL) AND (spec_snapshot IS NULL) AND (source_id IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint grants_actor_check CHECK (((actor IS NULL) OR ((octet_length(actor) >= 1) AND (octet_length(actor) <= 255))))
  constraint grants_amount_positive_check CHECK (((amount IS NULL) OR (amount > 0)))
  constraint grants_credit_amount_check CHECK (((kind <> 'credit'::text) OR ((amount IS NOT NULL) AND (currency IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint grants_currency_check CHECK (((currency IS NULL) OR (currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text)))
  constraint grants_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint grants_customer_id_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint grants_customer_id_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint grants_customer_id_supersedes_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, supersedes_id) REFERENCES billing.grants(merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint grants_event_check CHECK ((event = ANY (ARRAY['grant'::text, 'revoke'::text, 'expire'::text, 'supersede'::text])))
  constraint grants_event_supersedes_check CHECK (((event = 'grant'::text) = (supersedes_id IS NULL)))
  constraint grants_grant_reason_check CHECK (((grant_reason IS NULL) OR ((grant_reason = ANY (ARRAY['comp'::text, 'staff'::text, 'import'::text, 'migration'::text])) AND (kind = 'access'::text) AND (source_type = 'grant'::text))))
  constraint grants_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['entitlement'::text, 'ownership'::text, 'credit'::text, 'access'::text])))
  constraint grants_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint grants_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint grants_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, product_id) REFERENCES billing.products(merchant_id, id)
  constraint grants_quantity_check CHECK (((quantity IS NULL) OR (quantity >= 1)))
  constraint grants_source_id_check CHECK (((octet_length(source_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(source_id) <= 255)))
  constraint grants_source_type_check CHECK ((source_type = ANY (ARRAY['purchase'::text, 'subscription'::text, 'admin'::text, 'grace'::text, 'grant'::text])))
  constraint grants_termination_no_window_check CHECK (((event = 'grant'::text) OR (ends_at IS NULL)))
  constraint grants_valid_window_check CHECK (((ends_at IS NULL) OR (starts_at < ends_at)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_access_idempotency_key ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, source_id) WHERE ((kind = 'access'::text) AND (event = 'grant'::text) AND (source_type = 'grant'::text) AND (grant_reason <> 'migration'::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_access_once_key ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, product_id, source_type, source_id, starts_at) WHERE ((kind = 'access'::text) AND (event = 'grant'::text) AND (source_type <> 'grace'::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_access_purchase_key ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, payment_id, product_id) WHERE ((kind = 'access'::text) AND (event = 'grant'::text) AND (source_type = 'purchase'::text))
  index CREATE INDEX grants_created_at_idx ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, created_at) WHERE (kind = 'credit'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX grants_customer_id_currency_starts_at_ends_at_idx ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, starts_at, ends_at) WHERE ((kind = 'credit'::text) AND (event = 'grant'::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_customer_id_id_key ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX grants_customer_id_kind_idx ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, kind) WHERE (event = 'grant'::text)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_customer_id_source_id_key ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, source_id) WHERE ((kind = 'credit'::text) AND (event = 'grant'::text) AND (source_id IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX grants_ends_at_idx ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, ends_at) WHERE ((kind = 'credit'::text) AND (event = 'grant'::text) AND (ends_at IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX grants_payment_id_idx ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, payment_id) WHERE (payment_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_pkey ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX grants_product_id_idx ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, product_id) WHERE (product_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_purchased_credit_payment_key ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, payment_id) WHERE ((kind = 'credit'::text) AND (event = 'grant'::text) AND (payment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (((spec_snapshot -> 'deposit'::text) -> 'paid_amount'::text) IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX grants_source_type_source_id_idx ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, source_type, source_id) WHERE (source_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX grants_supersedes_id_idx ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, supersedes_id) WHERE (supersedes_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_supersedes_id_key ON billing.grants USING btree (merchant_id, supersedes_id) WHERE ((supersedes_id IS NOT NULL) AND (event = ANY (ARRAY['revoke'::text, 'expire'::text, 'supersede'::text])))
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_grants BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.grants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_grants_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON billing.grants FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()

table billing.host_outbox
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column event_type text NOT NULL
  column subject_type text NOT NULL
  column payment_id uuid
  column amount bigint
  column subject_id uuid NOT NULL
  column currency text
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column data jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column delivered_at timestamp with time zone
  column dedupe_key text NOT NULL
  constraint host_outbox_currency_check CHECK ((((currency IS NULL) = (event_type = ANY (ARRAY['product.entitlements_changed'::text, 'customer.network_linked'::text, 'customer.network_unlinked'::text, 'mandate.revoked'::text, 'destructive.hold_opened'::text, 'destructive.hold_cleared'::text]))) AND ((currency IS NULL) OR (currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))))
  constraint host_outbox_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint host_outbox_payload_check CHECK ((((event_type = 'payment.settled'::text) AND (subject_type = 'payment'::text) AND (payment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (subject_id = payment_id) AND (amount IS NOT NULL) AND (amount > 0) AND (data = '{}'::jsonb)) OR ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['delinquency.grace'::text, 'delinquency.entered'::text, 'delinquency.cleared'::text, 'balance.low'::text, 'balance.depleted'::text])) AND (subject_type = 'customer'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (amount IS NULL)) OR ((event_type = 'product.entitlements_changed'::text) AND (subject_type = 'product'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (amount IS NULL)) OR ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['order.completed'::text, 'order.requires_action'::text, 'order.payment_failed'::text, 'order.canceled'::text, 'order.expired'::text, 'order.voided'::text])) AND (subject_type = 'order'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (amount IS NOT NULL) AND (amount >= 0) AND (currency IS NOT NULL)) OR ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['customer.network_linked'::text, 'customer.network_unlinked'::text])) AND (subject_type = 'customer'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (amount IS NULL)) OR ((event_type = 'mandate.revoked'::text) AND (subject_type = 'mandate'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (amount IS NULL)) OR ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['destructive.hold_opened'::text, 'destructive.hold_cleared'::text])) AND (subject_type = 'destructive_hold'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (amount IS NULL) AND (currency IS NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object'::text))))
  constraint host_outbox_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint host_outbox_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX host_outbox_dedupe_key_key ON billing.host_outbox USING btree (merchant_id, dedupe_key)
  index CREATE INDEX host_outbox_delivered_at_idx ON billing.host_outbox USING btree (merchant_id, delivered_at) WHERE (delivered_at IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX host_outbox_event_type_id_idx ON billing.host_outbox USING btree (merchant_id, event_type, id) WHERE (delivered_at IS NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX host_outbox_payment_id_key ON billing.host_outbox USING btree (merchant_id, payment_id) WHERE (payment_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX host_outbox_pkey ON billing.host_outbox USING btree (merchant_id, id)

table billing.idempotency_keys
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column operation text NOT NULL
  column idempotency_key text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column token uuid NOT NULL
  column claims bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  column result jsonb
  column error text
  column lease_expires_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column expires_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint idempotency_keys_claims_check CHECK ((claims > 0))
  constraint idempotency_keys_expiry_check CHECK ((expires_at >= lease_expires_at))
  constraint idempotency_keys_idempotency_key_check CHECK (((octet_length(idempotency_key) >= 1) AND (octet_length(idempotency_key) <= 512)))
  constraint idempotency_keys_identity_check CHECK (((operation <> ''::text) AND (idempotency_key <> ''::text)))
  constraint idempotency_keys_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint idempotency_keys_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, operation, idempotency_key)
  constraint idempotency_keys_result_check CHECK (((status = 'succeeded'::text) OR (result IS NULL)))
  constraint idempotency_keys_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['processing'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX idempotency_keys_expires_at_idx ON billing.idempotency_keys USING btree (expires_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idempotency_keys_pkey ON billing.idempotency_keys USING btree (merchant_id, operation, idempotency_key)

table billing.ledger_accounts
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid
  column account_type text NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column debits_must_not_exceed_credits boolean NOT NULL
  column credits_must_not_exceed_debits boolean NOT NULL
  column credits_posted bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column debits_posted bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint ledger_accounts_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint ledger_accounts_customer_id_currency_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id)
  constraint ledger_accounts_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint ledger_accounts_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint ledger_accounts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint ledger_accounts_type_check CHECK ((account_type = ANY (ARRAY['customer_balance'::text, 'platform_revenue'::text, 'processor_clearing'::text, 'arrears_liability'::text, 'expired_credits'::text, 'revoked_credits'::text, 'promotional_funding'::text, 'credit_refund_clearing'::text, 'credit_refund_loss'::text])))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_accounts_account_type_currency_key ON billing.ledger_accounts USING btree (merchant_id, account_type, currency) WHERE (customer_id IS NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_accounts_customer_id_account_type_currency_key ON billing.ledger_accounts USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, account_type, currency) WHERE (customer_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_accounts_customer_id_currency_id_key ON billing.ledger_accounts USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_accounts_pkey ON billing.ledger_accounts USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER guard_ledger_account_facts BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.ledger_accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_ledger_account_facts()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_ledger_accounts_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON billing.ledger_accounts FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()

table billing.ledger_transfers
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column debit_account_id uuid NOT NULL
  column credit_account_id uuid NOT NULL
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column transfer_type text NOT NULL
  column allow_debit_negative_up_to bigint NOT NULL
  column source text NOT NULL
  column source_id text NOT NULL
  column grant_id uuid
  column customer_id uuid
  column invoker_id text
  column resource text
  column order_id uuid
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column operation text NOT NULL
  constraint ledger_transfers_amount_positive_check CHECK ((amount > 0))
  constraint ledger_transfers_coordinate_not_blank_check CHECK (((operation <> ''::text) AND (source <> ''::text) AND (source_id <> ''::text)))
  constraint ledger_transfers_credit_account_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, credit_account_id) REFERENCES billing.ledger_accounts(merchant_id, id)
  constraint ledger_transfers_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint ledger_transfers_customer_id_currency_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id)
  constraint ledger_transfers_debit_account_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, debit_account_id) REFERENCES billing.ledger_accounts(merchant_id, id)
  constraint ledger_transfers_debit_floor_nonnegative_check CHECK ((allow_debit_negative_up_to >= 0))
  constraint ledger_transfers_distinct_accounts_check CHECK ((debit_account_id <> credit_account_id))
  constraint ledger_transfers_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint ledger_transfers_operation_check CHECK (((octet_length(operation) >= 1) AND (octet_length(operation) <= 512)))
  constraint ledger_transfers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint ledger_transfers_source_check CHECK (((octet_length(source) >= 1) AND (octet_length(source) <= 512)))
  constraint ledger_transfers_source_id_check CHECK (((octet_length(source_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(source_id) <= 512)))
  constraint ledger_transfers_type_check CHECK ((transfer_type = ANY (ARRAY['deposit'::text, 'deposit_bonus'::text, 'credit_purchase_revenue'::text, 'credit_spend'::text, 'credit_expire'::text, 'credit_revoke'::text, 'credit_reinstate'::text, 'owed_accrual'::text, 'owed_payment'::text, 'owed_writeoff'::text, 'owed_repayment'::text, 'credit_refund'::text, 'credit_refund_restore'::text, 'credit_refund_cash'::text, 'credit_refund_cash_restore'::text, 'credit_refund_funding'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX ledger_transfers_created_at_idx ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, created_at)
  index CREATE INDEX ledger_transfers_credit_account_id_idx ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, credit_account_id)
  index CREATE INDEX ledger_transfers_customer_id_currency_created_at_idx ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, created_at DESC) WHERE (customer_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_transfers_customer_id_currency_id_key ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id)
  index CREATE INDEX ledger_transfers_debit_account_id_idx ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, debit_account_id)
  index CREATE INDEX ledger_transfers_grant_id_idx ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, grant_id) WHERE (grant_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_transfers_grant_id_transfer_type_key ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, grant_id, transfer_type) WHERE ((grant_id IS NOT NULL) AND (transfer_type = ANY (ARRAY['deposit'::text, 'deposit_bonus'::text, 'credit_purchase_revenue'::text, 'credit_expire'::text, 'credit_revoke'::text])))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_transfers_operation_once_key ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, transfer_type, operation, source, source_id, grant_id) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_transfers_pkey ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX ledger_transfers_source_source_id_idx ON billing.ledger_transfers USING btree (merchant_id, source, source_id)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_ledger_transfers BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.ledger_transfers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_ledger_transfers_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON billing.ledger_transfers FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER trg_ledger_transfers_apply_counters AFTER INSERT ON billing.ledger_transfers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.ledger_transfers_apply_counters()

table billing.maintenance_runs
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column actor text
  column psp_id uuid
  column mode text
  column rails text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::text[]
  column window_starts_at timestamp with time zone
  column window_ends_at timestamp with time zone
  column started_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column finished_at timestamp with time zone
  column status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running'::text
  column dry_run boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column coverage jsonb
  column expected_rows bigint
  column affected jsonb
  column reversed_at timestamp with time zone
  column reversed_by text
  column note text
  column summary jsonb
  column error text
  column inventory_manifest jsonb
  column inventory_total_rows bigint
  column run_class text NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN (kind = 'reconciliation'::text) THEN 'observation'::text WHEN (kind = 'purge_inventory'::text) THEN 'inventory'::text WHEN (kind = 'billing_restore'::text) THEN 'restore'::text ELSE 'destructive'::text END) STORED
  constraint maintenance_runs_actor_check CHECK ((actor <> ''::text))
  constraint maintenance_runs_expected_rows_check CHECK (((expected_rows IS NULL) OR (expected_rows >= 0)))
  constraint maintenance_runs_id_run_class_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, id, run_class)
  constraint maintenance_runs_kind_check CHECK (((((kind = 'reconciliation'::text) AND (mode = ANY (ARRAY['advisory'::text, 'enforce'::text])) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'completed'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND (psp_id IS NULL) AND (NOT dry_run) AND (coverage IS NULL) AND (expected_rows IS NULL) AND (affected IS NULL) AND (reversed_at IS NULL) AND (reversed_by IS NULL) AND (inventory_manifest IS NULL) AND (inventory_total_rows IS NULL)) OR ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['prune'::text, 'approval'::text, 'merchant_purge'::text])) AND (btrim(actor) <> ''::text) AND (mode IS NULL) AND (cardinality(rails) = 0) AND (window_starts_at IS NULL) AND (window_ends_at IS NULL) AND (summary IS NULL) AND (error IS NULL) AND (inventory_manifest IS NULL) AND (inventory_total_rows IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'billing_restore'::text) AND (actor = 'merchantarchive'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'completed'::text])) AND (mode IS NULL) AND (cardinality(rails) = 0) AND (psp_id IS NULL) AND (NOT dry_run) AND (window_starts_at IS NULL) AND (window_ends_at IS NULL) AND (coverage IS NULL) AND (expected_rows IS NULL) AND (affected IS NULL) AND (reversed_at IS NULL) AND (reversed_by IS NULL) AND (note IS NULL) AND (error IS NULL) AND (inventory_manifest IS NULL) AND (inventory_total_rows IS NULL) AND (((status = 'running'::text) AND (finished_at IS NULL) AND (summary IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'completed'::text) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(summary) = 'object'::text) AND (summary ?& ARRAY['digest'::text, 'rows'::text]) AND (jsonb_typeof((summary -> 'digest'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((summary -> 'rows'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND ((summary ->> 'digest'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (((summary ->> 'rows'::text))::bigint >= 0)))) OR ((kind = 'purge_inventory'::text) AND (status = 'completed'::text) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (mode IS NULL) AND (cardinality(rails) = 0) AND (psp_id IS NULL) AND (window_starts_at IS NULL) AND (window_ends_at IS NULL) AND (NOT dry_run) AND (coverage IS NULL) AND (expected_rows IS NULL) AND (affected IS NULL) AND (reversed_at IS NULL) AND (reversed_by IS NULL) AND (summary IS NULL) AND (error IS NULL) AND (inventory_manifest IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(inventory_manifest) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((inventory_manifest -> 'total_rows'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND (inventory_total_rows IS NOT NULL) AND (inventory_total_rows >= 0) AND (inventory_total_rows = ((inventory_manifest ->> 'total_rows'::text))::bigint))) IS TRUE))
  constraint maintenance_runs_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint maintenance_runs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint maintenance_runs_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint maintenance_runs_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'reversed'::text])))
  constraint require_finished_billing_restore TRIGGER DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
  index CREATE INDEX maintenance_runs_id_idx ON billing.maintenance_runs USING btree (id) WHERE ((kind = 'merchant_purge'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND ((affected ->> 'database_purged'::text) = 'true'::text) AND (coverage ? 'secret_cleanup'::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX maintenance_runs_id_run_class_key ON billing.maintenance_runs USING btree (merchant_id, id, run_class)
  index CREATE INDEX maintenance_runs_kind_started_at_idx ON billing.maintenance_runs USING btree (merchant_id, kind, started_at DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX maintenance_runs_merchant_id_key ON billing.maintenance_runs USING btree (merchant_id) WHERE (kind = 'billing_restore'::text)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX maintenance_runs_pkey ON billing.maintenance_runs USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER guard_billing_restore_receipt BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.maintenance_runs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_billing_restore_receipt()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_maintenance_run_facts BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.maintenance_runs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_billing_fact_columns('finished_at', 'status', 'summary', 'error', 'affected', 'reversed_at', 'reversed_by', 'note', 'run_class')
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_maintenance_runs_delete BEFORE DELETE ON billing.maintenance_runs FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.kind <> 'reconciliation'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_maintenance_runs_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON billing.maintenance_runs FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER require_finished_billing_restore AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON billing.maintenance_runs DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.require_finished_billing_restore()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER retained_reconciliation_runs BEFORE DELETE ON billing.maintenance_runs FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.kind = 'reconciliation'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_retention_delete('started_at', '366 days')

table billing.mandates
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column payment_method_id uuid
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid
  column currency text
  column status text NOT NULL
  column end_reason text
  column ended_at timestamp with time zone
  column card_brand text
  column initial_transaction_id text
  column network_transaction_id text
  column transaction_link_id text
  column storing_attempt_id uuid
  column accepted_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint mandates_card_brand_check CHECK ((card_brand <> ''::text))
  constraint mandates_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint mandates_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint mandates_end_check CHECK ((((status = ANY (ARRAY['revoked'::text, 'ended'::text])) = (end_reason IS NOT NULL)) AND ((end_reason IS NULL) = (ended_at IS NULL))))
  constraint mandates_end_reason_check CHECK (((end_reason = ANY (ARRAY['replaced'::text, 'brand_changed'::text, 'closed'::text, 'customer_revoked'::text, 'subscription_ended'::text, 'payment_method_removed'::text])) AND ((status = 'revoked'::text) = (end_reason = 'customer_revoked'::text))))
  constraint mandates_initial_transaction_id_check CHECK ((initial_transaction_id <> ''::text))
  constraint mandates_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['recurring'::text, 'unscheduled'::text, 'card_on_file'::text])))
  constraint mandates_live_method_check CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['revoked'::text, 'ended'::text])) OR (payment_method_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint mandates_network_transaction_id_check CHECK ((network_transaction_id <> ''::text))
  constraint mandates_payment_method_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, payment_method_id) REFERENCES billing.payment_methods(merchant_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (payment_method_id)
  constraint mandates_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint mandates_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint mandates_scope_check CHECK ((((kind = 'recurring'::text) = (subscription_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((kind = 'unscheduled'::text) = (currency IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint mandates_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'requires_reconsent'::text, 'revoked'::text, 'ended'::text])))
  constraint mandates_storing_attempt_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, storing_attempt_id) REFERENCES billing.payment_attempts(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (storing_attempt_id)
  constraint mandates_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint mandates_transaction_link_id_check CHECK ((length(transaction_link_id) = 22))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mandates_card_on_file_live_key ON billing.mandates USING btree (merchant_id, payment_method_id, psp_id) WHERE ((kind = 'card_on_file'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'requires_reconsent'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX mandates_customer_id_created_at_id_idx ON billing.mandates USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX mandates_payment_method_id_idx ON billing.mandates USING btree (merchant_id, payment_method_id, psp_id) WHERE (payment_method_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mandates_pkey ON billing.mandates USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mandates_recurring_live_key ON billing.mandates USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE ((kind = 'recurring'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'requires_reconsent'::text])))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mandates_unscheduled_live_key ON billing.mandates USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency) WHERE ((kind = 'unscheduled'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'requires_reconsent'::text])))
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER guard_mandate_update BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.mandates FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_mandate_update()

table billing.merchant_destructive_policy
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column destructive_actions_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  column enforce_armed_at timestamp with time zone
  column first_pull_completed_at timestamp with time zone
  column updated_by text
  column reason text
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint merchant_destructive_policy_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint merchant_destructive_policy_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX merchant_destructive_policy_pkey ON billing.merchant_destructive_policy USING btree (merchant_id)

table billing.merchant_slug_aliases
  column slug text NOT NULL
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column expires_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint merchant_slug_aliases_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint merchant_slug_aliases_pkey PRIMARY KEY (slug)
  index CREATE INDEX merchant_slug_aliases_merchant_id_idx ON billing.merchant_slug_aliases USING btree (merchant_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX merchant_slug_aliases_pkey ON billing.merchant_slug_aliases USING btree (slug)

table billing.merchant_write_posture
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column mode text NOT NULL
  column reason text NOT NULL
  column set_by text NOT NULL
  column set_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint merchant_write_posture_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint merchant_write_posture_mode_check CHECK ((mode = ANY (ARRAY['full'::text, 'limited'::text, 'readonly'::text])))
  constraint merchant_write_posture_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id)
  constraint merchant_write_posture_reason_check CHECK ((reason = ANY (ARRAY['exported'::text, 'restored'::text, 'operator'::text])))
  constraint merchant_write_posture_set_by_check CHECK ((set_by <> ''::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX merchant_write_posture_pkey ON billing.merchant_write_posture USING btree (merchant_id)

table billing.merchants
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column slug text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column permission_group_id text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column deleted_at timestamp with time zone
  column retired_at timestamp with time zone
  column group_release_completed_at timestamp with time zone
  column catalog_revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column slug_changed_at timestamp with time zone
  column entitlement_generation bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  constraint merchants_catalog_revision_check CHECK ((catalog_revision >= 0))
  constraint merchants_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint merchants_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'deleted'::text])))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX merchants_permission_group_id_key ON billing.merchants USING btree (permission_group_id) WHERE (permission_group_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX merchants_pkey ON billing.merchants USING btree (id)
  index CREATE INDEX merchants_retired_at_id_idx ON billing.merchants USING btree (retired_at, id) WHERE ((retired_at IS NOT NULL) AND (group_release_completed_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX merchants_slug_key ON billing.merchants USING btree (slug) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER guard_merchant_name BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF slug, deleted_at ON billing.merchants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_merchant_name()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER guard_merchant_restore BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.merchants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_merchant_restore()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_merchant_group_binding BEFORE UPDATE OF permission_group_id ON billing.merchants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_merchant_group_binding()

table billing.meter_period_quantities
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column meter_key text NOT NULL
  column cell text NOT NULL
  column period_starts_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column quantity bigint NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

  constraint meter_period_quantities_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint meter_period_quantities_meter_key_check CHECK ((meter_key <> ''::text))
  constraint meter_period_quantities_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, meter_key, cell, period_starts_at)

  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meter_period_quantities_pkey ON billing.meter_period_quantities USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, meter_key, cell, period_starts_at)

table billing.money_settings
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL

  column currency text NOT NULL
  column credit_limit_amount bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column default_payment_method_id uuid
  column collection_revoked_at timestamp with time zone
  constraint money_settings_billing_mode_check CHECK ((billing_mode = ANY (ARRAY['prepaid'::text, 'arrears'::text])))
  constraint money_settings_credit_limit_amount_nonneg_check CHECK ((credit_limit_amount >= 0))
  constraint money_settings_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint money_settings_customer_id_default_payment_method_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, default_payment_method_id) REFERENCES billing.payment_methods(merchant_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (default_payment_method_id)
  constraint money_settings_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint money_settings_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint money_settings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX money_settings_pkey ON billing.money_settings USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER trg_subscription_history_default AFTER UPDATE OF default_payment_method_id ON billing.money_settings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.subscription_history_default_card()
