  column revision bigint NOT NULL
  column credit_grant jsonb
  column ownership text
  column deleted_at timestamp with time zone
  column required_entitlements text[] COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::text[]
  constraint products_credit_grant_object CHECK (((credit_grant IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(credit_grant) = 'object'::text) AND COALESCE(((credit_grant ->> 'currency'::text) ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text), false) AND COALESCE(((((credit_grant ->> 'expires_after_days'::text))::integer >= 1) AND (((credit_grant ->> 'expires_after_days'::text))::integer <= 36500)), false) AND ((COALESCE((((credit_grant ->> 'amount'::text))::bigint > 0), false) AND (NOT COALESCE(((credit_grant ->> 'from_payment'::text))::boolean, false))) OR ((NOT (credit_grant ? 'amount'::text)) AND COALESCE(((credit_grant ->> 'from_payment'::text))::boolean, false))))))
  constraint products_deleted_archived_check CHECK (((deleted_at IS NULL) OR archived))
  constraint products_key_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, key)
  constraint products_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint products_ownership_check CHECK ((ownership = ANY (ARRAY['unique'::text, 'consumable'::text, 'extend'::text])))
  constraint products_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint products_required_entitlements_check CHECK (((cardinality(required_entitlements) <= 100) AND (array_position(required_entitlements, NULL::text) IS NULL)))
  constraint products_revision_check CHECK ((revision >= 1))
  constraint products_tier_group_check CHECK (((char_length(tier_group) >= 1) AND (char_length(tier_group) <= 100)))
  index CREATE INDEX products_archived_idx ON billing.products USING btree (archived)
  index CREATE INDEX products_created_at_id_idx ON billing.products USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX products_key_idx ON billing.products USING btree (key)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_key_key ON billing.products USING btree (merchant_id, key)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_pkey ON billing.products USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX products_tier_group_idx ON billing.products USING btree (tier_group) WHERE (tier_group IS NOT NULL)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authored_product BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_authored_write()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER catalog_product_offer_state AFTER UPDATE OF archived ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.catalog_product_offer_state()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_product_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_product_identity()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER no_product_delete BEFORE DELETE ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER no_product_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON billing.products FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER product_revision BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.assign_object_revision()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_guard_tier_group BEFORE UPDATE OF tier_group ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.products_guard_tier_group()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_propagate_tier_group AFTER UPDATE OF tier_group ON billing.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.products_propagate_tier_group()

table billing.provider_bills
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column source_kind text NOT NULL
  column source_key text NOT NULL
  column order_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column snapshot jsonb NOT NULL
  column provider_reference text NOT NULL
  column settlement_source text
  column non_cash_amount bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column settled_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint provider_bills_identity_check CHECK ((((octet_length(source_kind) >= 1) AND (octet_length(source_kind) <= 128)) AND ((octet_length(source_key) >= 1) AND (octet_length(source_key) <= 512)) AND (octet_length(provider_reference) <= 512)))
  constraint provider_bills_order_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, order_id) REFERENCES billing.orders(merchant_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_bills_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, source_kind, source_key)
  constraint provider_bills_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_bills_settlement_check CHECK (((non_cash_amount >= 0) AND ((settled_at IS NULL) = (settlement_source IS NULL)) AND (settlement_source = ANY (ARRAY['cash'::text, 'credit'::text, 'out_of_band'::text, 'mixed'::text]))))
  constraint provider_bills_snapshot_check CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(snapshot) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((snapshot)::text) <= 262144)))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_bills_order_id_idx ON billing.provider_bills USING btree (merchant_id, order_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_bills_pkey ON billing.provider_bills USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, source_kind, source_key)

table billing.provider_charge_attributions
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column transaction_id text NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid NOT NULL
  column declared_at timestamp with time zone
  column status text NOT NULL
  column attempts integer NOT NULL
  column next_attempt_at timestamp with time zone
  column payment_id uuid
  column resolved_at timestamp with time zone
  column reason text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint provider_charge_attributions_attempts_check CHECK ((attempts >= 0))
  constraint provider_charge_attributions_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_charge_attributions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, transaction_id)
  constraint provider_charge_attributions_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_charge_attributions_status_check CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND (next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (resolved_at IS NULL) AND (reason IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'resolved'::text) AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL) AND (payment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (reason IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'unresolvable'::text) AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (reason IS NOT NULL) AND (reason <> ''::text))))
  constraint provider_charge_attributions_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_charge_attributions_transaction_id_check CHECK (((octet_length(transaction_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(transaction_id) <= 128)))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_charge_attributions_due_idx ON billing.provider_charge_attributions USING btree (next_attempt_at, merchant_id) WHERE (status = 'pending'::text)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_charge_attributions_pkey ON billing.provider_charge_attributions USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, transaction_id)

table billing.provider_cycle_receipts
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column transaction_id text NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid NOT NULL
  column schedule_source_reference text NOT NULL
  column due_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column approved boolean NOT NULL
  constraint provider_cycle_receipts_amount_check CHECK ((amount >= 0))
  constraint provider_cycle_receipts_merchant_id_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id)
  constraint provider_cycle_receipts_merchant_id_subscription_id_schedu_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id, schedule_source_reference) REFERENCES billing.provider_schedules(merchant_id, subscription_id, source_reference)
  constraint provider_cycle_receipts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, transaction_id)
  constraint provider_cycle_receipts_transaction_id_check CHECK ((transaction_id <> ''::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_cycle_receipts_pkey ON billing.provider_cycle_receipts USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, transaction_id)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_cycle_receipts_settled_schedule_idx ON billing.provider_cycle_receipts USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, schedule_source_reference, due_at DESC) WHERE approved

table billing.provider_intents
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column intent_type text NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid
  column payment_id uuid
  column price_id uuid
  column payload jsonb
  column idempotency_key text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column next_attempt_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column lease_expires_at timestamp with time zone
  column origin text NOT NULL
  column origin_reason text
  column actor text
  column last_failure_reason text
  column expires_at timestamp with time zone
  column result_evidence jsonb
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column executed_at timestamp with time zone
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column psp_id uuid
  column destructive_run_id uuid
  column destructive_run_class text GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'destructive'::text ELSE NULL::text END) STORED
  column custodian_id uuid
  column subject text
  column credential text
  column destructive_action_id uuid
  constraint provider_intents_addressed_check CHECK (((psp_id IS NOT NULL) OR (custodian_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint provider_intents_credential_check CHECK ((credential <> ''::text))
  constraint provider_intents_custodian_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, custodian_id) REFERENCES billing.custodians(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_intents_destructive_action_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, destructive_action_id) REFERENCES billing.destructive_actions(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_intents_destructive_run_id_destructive_run_class_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, destructive_run_id, destructive_run_class) REFERENCES billing.maintenance_runs(merchant_id, id, run_class) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_intents_executed_check CHECK (((status <> 'succeeded'::text) OR (executed_at IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint provider_intents_idempotency_key_check CHECK (((octet_length(idempotency_key) >= 1) AND (octet_length(idempotency_key) <= 512)))
  constraint provider_intents_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_intents_origin_check CHECK ((origin = ANY (ARRAY['user'::text, 'admin'::text, 'system'::text, 'provider'::text])))
  constraint provider_intents_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (payment_id)
  constraint provider_intents_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint provider_intents_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (price_id)
  constraint provider_intents_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_intents_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text, 'failed_terminal'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'expired'::text])))
  constraint provider_intents_subject_check CHECK ((subject <> ''::text))
  constraint provider_intents_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (subscription_id)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_actor_created_at_intent_type_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (actor, created_at, intent_type) WHERE (origin = ANY (ARRAY['user'::text, 'admin'::text]))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_custodian_method_delete_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, custodian_id, (((payload -> 'instrument'::text) ->> 'rail_method_ref'::text))) WHERE (intent_type = 'hyperswitch_method_delete'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_destructive_action_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, destructive_action_id) WHERE (destructive_action_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_destructive_run_id_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, destructive_run_id) WHERE (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_idempotency_key_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, idempotency_key)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_initial_membership_history_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, (((payload -> 'terms'::text) ->> 'subscription_id'::text))) WHERE ((intent_type = 'initial_membership'::text) AND (status = 'succeeded'::text))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_native_vault_delete_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, ((payload ->> 'rail_customer_ref'::text))) WHERE (intent_type = 'nmi_vault_delete'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_next_attempt_at_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (next_attempt_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text]))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_obligation_unreleased_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, ((payload ->> 'order_reference'::text))) WHERE ((intent_type = ANY (ARRAY['subscription_collection'::text, 'manual_rebill'::text])) AND (status <> ALL (ARRAY['failed_terminal'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'expired'::text])))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_open_subscription_collection_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE ((intent_type = 'subscription_collection'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_order_attempt_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, ((payload ->> 'order_attempt_id'::text))) WHERE (payload ? 'order_attempt_id'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_origin_created_at_intent_type_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, origin, created_at, intent_type)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_pkey ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_psp_id_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id) WHERE (psp_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_subscription_collection_slot_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, ((payload ->> 'previous_period_end'::text)), ((payload ->> 'attempt'::text))) WHERE (intent_type = 'subscription_collection'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_subscription_id_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE (subscription_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_subscription_id_open_manual_rebill_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE ((intent_type = 'manual_rebill'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text])))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_intents_subscription_id_tier_change_subscription_key ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE ((intent_type = ANY (ARRAY['nmi_upgrade'::text, 'stripe_tier_change'::text, 'initial_membership'::text])) AND (subscription_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_flight'::text, 'unknown_needs_verify'::text, 'failed_retryable'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX provider_intents_updated_at_idx ON billing.provider_intents USING btree (merchant_id, updated_at) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['succeeded'::text, 'failed_terminal'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'expired'::text])) AND (destructive_run_id IS NULL) AND (intent_type = ANY (ARRAY['nmi_delete_subscription'::text, 'stripe_cancel_subscription'::text, 'ccbill_cancel_subscription'::text, 'nmi_payment_method_update'::text, 'nmi_payment_source_update'::text, 'nmi_card_vault'::text, 'network_token'::text, 'stripe_archive_price'::text, 'stripe_archive_product'::text, 'solana_sunset_plan'::text, 'bt_account_updater_batch'::text])))

table billing.provider_mutation_logs
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid
  column provider_intent_id uuid
  column intent_type text
  column idempotency_key text
  column attempt integer NOT NULL
  column phase text NOT NULL
  column reason text
  column evidence jsonb
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column custodian_id uuid
  column origin text
  column actor text
  column executor text
  column operation_id uuid
  column subscription_id uuid
  column reason_code text
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_addressed_check CHECK (((psp_id IS NOT NULL) OR (custodian_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_custodian_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, custodian_id) REFERENCES billing.custodians(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_phase_check CHECK ((phase = ANY (ARRAY['attempting'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'parked'::text])))
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_provider_intent_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, provider_intent_id) REFERENCES billing.provider_intents(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (provider_intent_id)
  constraint provider_mutation_logs_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_created_at_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_custodian_id_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, custodian_id) WHERE (custodian_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_operation_history_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, operation_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (phase = ANY (ARRAY['parked'::text, 'attempting'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text]))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_pkey ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_provider_intent_id_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, provider_intent_id) WHERE (provider_intent_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_psp_id_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id) WHERE (psp_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_rail_phase_created_at_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (rail, phase, created_at DESC)
  index CREATE INDEX provider_mutation_logs_subscription_history_idx ON billing.provider_mutation_logs USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (subscription_id IS NOT NULL)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_provider_mutation_log_content BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.provider_mutation_logs FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((NOT ((new.provider_intent_id IS NULL) AND ((to_jsonb(new.*) - 'provider_intent_id'::text) = (to_jsonb(old.*) - 'provider_intent_id'::text))))) EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()

table billing.provider_schedules
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column initial_order_id uuid
  column accepted_version bigint NOT NULL
  column source_reference text NOT NULL
  column provider_reference text NOT NULL
  column first_due_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column cadence_hours integer NOT NULL
  column cadence_months integer NOT NULL
  column accepted_bill jsonb NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint provider_schedules_accepted_version_check CHECK ((accepted_version > 0))
  constraint provider_schedules_cadence_hours_check CHECK ((cadence_hours >= 0))
  constraint provider_schedules_cadence_months_check CHECK (((cadence_months >= 0) AND (cadence_months <= 1200)))
  constraint provider_schedules_check CHECK (((cadence_hours > 0) <> (cadence_months > 0)))
  constraint provider_schedules_merchant_id_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint provider_schedules_merchant_id_initial_order_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, initial_order_id) REFERENCES billing.orders(merchant_id, id)
  constraint provider_schedules_merchant_id_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id)
  constraint provider_schedules_merchant_id_subscription_id_accepted_ver_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, subscription_id, accepted_version)
  constraint provider_schedules_merchant_id_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id)
  constraint provider_schedules_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id, source_reference)
  constraint provider_schedules_provider_reference_check CHECK (((octet_length(provider_reference) >= 1) AND (octet_length(provider_reference) <= 512)))
  constraint provider_schedules_source_reference_check CHECK (((octet_length(source_reference) >= 1) AND (octet_length(source_reference) <= 512)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_schedules_merchant_id_subscription_id_accepted_ver_key ON billing.provider_schedules USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, accepted_version)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_schedules_pkey ON billing.provider_schedules USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, source_reference)

table billing.provisioning_tokens
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column name text NOT NULL
  column declared boolean NOT NULL
  column token_sha256 bytea NOT NULL
  column last_used_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint provisioning_tokens_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint provisioning_tokens_name_check CHECK (((name = btrim(name)) AND (name <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(name) <= 128)))
  constraint provisioning_tokens_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint provisioning_tokens_token_sha256_check CHECK ((octet_length(token_sha256) = 32))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provisioning_tokens_declared_key ON billing.provisioning_tokens USING btree (merchant_id) WHERE declared
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provisioning_tokens_pkey ON billing.provisioning_tokens USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provisioning_tokens_token_sha256_key ON billing.provisioning_tokens USING btree (token_sha256)

table billing.psp_customers
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column remote_customer_ref text NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint psp_customers_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint psp_customers_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint psp_customers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint psp_customers_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint psp_customers_remote_customer_ref_check CHECK ((btrim(remote_customer_ref) <> ''::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psp_customers_customer_id_psp_id_key ON billing.psp_customers USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, psp_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psp_customers_pkey ON billing.psp_customers USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psp_customers_psp_id_remote_customer_ref_key ON billing.psp_customers USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, remote_customer_ref)

table billing.psp_import_mappings
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column mapping text NOT NULL
  column key text NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint psp_import_mappings_key_check CHECK (((key <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(key) <= 256)))
  constraint psp_import_mappings_mapping_check CHECK ((mapping ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$'::text))
  constraint psp_import_mappings_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint psp_import_mappings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, mapping, key)
  index CREATE INDEX psp_import_mappings_customer_idx ON billing.psp_import_mappings USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psp_import_mappings_pkey ON billing.psp_import_mappings USING btree (merchant_id, mapping, key)

table billing.psp_import_records
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column import_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column ref text NOT NULL
  column customer_ref text
  column subscription_ref text
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone
  column facts jsonb NOT NULL
  column data jsonb NOT NULL
  column state text NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid
  column linked_via text
  column manual_customer_id uuid
  column reason text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint psp_import_records_data_check CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object'::text))
  constraint psp_import_records_facts_check CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(facts) = 'object'::text))
  constraint psp_import_records_import_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, import_id) REFERENCES billing.psp_imports(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint psp_import_records_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['customer'::text, 'subscription'::text, 'transaction'::text])))
  constraint psp_import_records_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint psp_import_records_reason_check CHECK ((((reason IS NULL) OR (reason <> ''::text)) AND ((state <> ALL (ARRAY['conflict'::text, 'blocked'::text])) OR (reason IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint psp_import_records_ref_check CHECK (((ref <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(ref) <= 256)))
  constraint psp_import_records_ref_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, import_id, kind, ref)
  constraint psp_import_records_refs_check CHECK ((((customer_ref IS NULL) OR (customer_ref <> ''::text)) AND ((subscription_ref IS NULL) OR (subscription_ref <> ''::text))))
  constraint psp_import_records_state_check CHECK ((((state = ANY (ARRAY['unmatched'::text, 'conflict'::text])) AND (customer_id IS NULL) AND (linked_via IS NULL)) OR ((state = ANY (ARRAY['linked'::text, 'imported'::text, 'blocked'::text])) AND (customer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (linked_via IS NOT NULL) AND (linked_via <> ''::text))))
  index CREATE INDEX psp_import_records_kind_idx ON billing.psp_import_records USING btree (merchant_id, import_id, kind, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psp_import_records_pkey ON billing.psp_import_records USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psp_import_records_ref_key ON billing.psp_import_records USING btree (merchant_id, import_id, kind, ref)
  index CREATE INDEX psp_import_records_state_idx ON billing.psp_import_records USING btree (merchant_id, import_id, state, kind, id)

table billing.psp_imports
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column history_since timestamp with time zone
  column history_through timestamp with time zone
  column pulled_at timestamp with time zone
  column applied_at timestamp with time zone
  column error text
  column rules jsonb NOT NULL
  column products jsonb NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint psp_imports_error_check CHECK ((((status = 'failed'::text) = (error IS NOT NULL)) AND ((error IS NULL) OR (error <> ''::text))))
  constraint psp_imports_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint psp_imports_products_check CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(products) = 'array'::text))
  constraint psp_imports_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint psp_imports_rules_check CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(rules) = 'array'::text))
  constraint psp_imports_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pulling'::text, 'pulled'::text, 'applying'::text, 'applied'::text, 'failed'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX psp_imports_created_at_id_idx ON billing.psp_imports USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psp_imports_pkey ON billing.psp_imports USING btree (merchant_id, id)

table billing.psp_refresh_watermarks
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column event_domain text NOT NULL
  column watermark_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint psp_refresh_watermarks_event_domain_check CHECK ((event_domain = ANY (ARRAY['events'::text, 'applied_events'::text, 'completed_events'::text])))
  constraint psp_refresh_watermarks_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint psp_refresh_watermarks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, event_domain)
  constraint psp_refresh_watermarks_psp_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psp_refresh_watermarks_pkey ON billing.psp_refresh_watermarks USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, event_domain)

table billing.psps
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column key text NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column environment text NOT NULL
  column account_id text NOT NULL
  column credentials_validated_at timestamp with time zone
  column webhook_endpoint_id text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column credential_fingerprint text
  column credential_duplicate_at timestamp with time zone
  column superseded_at timestamp with time zone
  column live boolean NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((environment = ANY (ARRAY['live'::text, 'mainnet'::text]))) STORED
  constraint psps_credential_fingerprint_check CHECK ((credential_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
  constraint psps_environment_check CHECK ( CASE WHEN (rail = 'solana'::text) THEN (environment = ANY (ARRAY['mainnet'::text, 'devnet'::text, 'testnet'::text])) ELSE (environment = ANY (ARRAY['live'::text, 'test'::text, 'sandbox'::text])) END)
  constraint psps_id_rail_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, id, rail)
  constraint psps_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint psps_nonempty_check CHECK (((btrim(key) <> ''::text) AND (btrim(account_id) <> ''::text)))
  constraint psps_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint psps_rail_check CHECK ((rail = ANY (ARRAY['nmi'::text, 'ccbill'::text, 'stripe'::text, 'solana'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX psps_environment_rail_created_at_id_idx ON billing.psps USING btree (merchant_id, environment, rail, created_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psps_id_rail_key ON billing.psps USING btree (merchant_id, id, rail)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psps_key_key ON billing.psps USING btree (merchant_id, lower(key)) WHERE (superseded_at IS NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psps_live_credential_fingerprint_key ON billing.psps USING btree (rail, environment, credential_fingerprint) WHERE ((credential_duplicate_at IS NULL) AND (credential_fingerprint IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psps_pkey ON billing.psps USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX psps_rail_live_account_id_key ON billing.psps USING btree (rail, live, account_id)

table billing.rebill_cycles
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column owner text NOT NULL
  column due_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column missed_at timestamp with time zone
  column miss_reason text
  column quantity integer
  constraint rebill_cycles_amount_check CHECK ((amount >= 0))
  constraint rebill_cycles_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint rebill_cycles_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint rebill_cycles_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint rebill_cycles_miss_reason_check CHECK ((miss_reason = ANY (ARRAY['held'::text, 'refused'::text, 'method_unusable'::text, 'not_attempted'::text, 'provider_skipped'::text, 'provider_stalled'::text, 'provider_reversed'::text, 'provider_unrecorded'::text, 'schedule_gone'::text])))
  constraint rebill_cycles_missed_check CHECK (((missed_at IS NULL) = (miss_reason IS NULL)))
  constraint rebill_cycles_owner_check CHECK ((owner = ANY (ARRAY['engine'::text, 'nmi_schedule'::text, 'provider'::text])))
  constraint rebill_cycles_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint rebill_cycles_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint rebill_cycles_quantity_check CHECK (((quantity IS NULL) OR (quantity >= 1)))
  constraint rebill_cycles_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index CREATE INDEX rebill_cycles_customer_id_idx ON billing.rebill_cycles USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id)
  index CREATE INDEX rebill_cycles_due_at_idx ON billing.rebill_cycles USING btree (merchant_id, due_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rebill_cycles_pkey ON billing.rebill_cycles USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX rebill_cycles_psp_id_due_at_idx ON billing.rebill_cycles USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, due_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rebill_cycles_subscription_id_due_at_key ON billing.rebill_cycles USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, due_at)

table billing.reconciliation_findings
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column finding_type text NOT NULL
  column rail text
  column psp_id uuid
  column openrails_resource_type text
  column openrails_resource_id text
  column external_resource_id text
  column field text
  column openrails_value text
  column external_value text
  column subject_key text NOT NULL
  column severity text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column recommended_action text
  column first_seen_run uuid
  column last_seen_run uuid
  column last_seen_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column resolved_at timestamp with time zone
  column resolution text
  column operator_notes text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column evidence jsonb
  column resolved_by text
  column notified_at timestamp with time zone
  column notified_severity text
  column seen_run_class text GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN ((first_seen_run IS NOT NULL) OR (last_seen_run IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'observation'::text ELSE NULL::text END) STORED
  column change jsonb
  column source text
  column evidence_digest text
  column approval_run_id uuid
  constraint reconciliation_findings_approval_run_check CHECK (((NOT (resolution IS DISTINCT FROM 'approved'::text)) = (approval_run_id IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_approval_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, approval_run_id) REFERENCES billing.maintenance_runs(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint reconciliation_findings_catalog_check CHECK ((((finding_type = ANY (ARRAY['catalog.orphan_in_stripe'::text, 'catalog.missing_in_stripe'::text, 'catalog.orphan_in_nmi'::text, 'catalog.missing_in_nmi'::text, 'catalog.missing_in_solana'::text, 'catalog.field_drift'::text])) AND (rail = ANY (ARRAY['stripe'::text, 'nmi'::text, 'solana'::text])) AND (psp_id IS NOT NULL) AND (openrails_resource_type = ANY (ARRAY['product'::text, 'price'::text])) AND ((finding_type = 'catalog.field_drift'::text) OR (finding_type ~~ ('catalog.%_in_'::text || rail))) AND (first_seen_run IS NULL) AND (last_seen_run IS NULL) AND (subject_key = (jsonb_build_array((psp_id)::text, openrails_resource_type, COALESCE(openrails_resource_id, ''::text), COALESCE(external_resource_id, ''::text), COALESCE(field, ''::text)))::text)) OR ((finding_type !~~ 'catalog.%'::text) AND (openrails_resource_type IS NULL) AND (openrails_resource_id IS NULL) AND (external_resource_id IS NULL) AND (field IS NULL) AND (openrails_value IS NULL) AND (external_value IS NULL) AND (((rail IS NULL) AND (psp_id IS NULL)) OR ((finding_type ~~ 'pull.%'::text) AND (rail IS NOT NULL) AND (psp_id IS NOT NULL))))))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_change_check CHECK (((change IS NULL) OR ((finding_type ~~ 'pull.%'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(change) = 'object'::text) AND ((change ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['create_subscription'::text, 'record_charge'::text, 'record_refund'::text, 'adopt_subscription'::text, 'cancel_subscription'::text, 'update_card'::text, 'revoke_access'::text, 'refund_charge_after_cancel'::text, 'cancel_provider_schedule'::text, 'collect_skipped_renewal'::text])))))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_evidence_digest_check CHECK ((((change IS NULL) = (evidence_digest IS NULL)) AND ((evidence_digest IS NULL) OR (evidence_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_first_seen_run_seen_run_class_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, first_seen_run, seen_run_class) REFERENCES billing.maintenance_runs(merchant_id, id, run_class) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint reconciliation_findings_last_seen_run_seen_run_class_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, last_seen_run, seen_run_class) REFERENCES billing.maintenance_runs(merchant_id, id, run_class) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint reconciliation_findings_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint reconciliation_findings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint reconciliation_findings_proposal_resolution_check CHECK (((resolution IS NULL) OR (resolution <> ALL (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'dismissed'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'foreign'::text])) OR (finding_type ~~ 'pull.%'::text)))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint reconciliation_findings_resolution_check CHECK (((resolution IS NULL) OR (resolution = ANY (ARRAY['auto_vanished'::text, 'enforced'::text, 'admin_fixed'::text, 'ignored'::text, 'approved'::text, 'dismissed'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'foreign'::text]))))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_resolved_fields_check CHECK ((((status = ANY (ARRAY['auto_fixed'::text, 'fixed'::text, 'ignored'::text])) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (resolution IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['reconcile_required'::text, 'requires_review'::text])) AND (resolved_at IS NULL) AND (resolution IS NULL))))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_severity_check CHECK ((severity = ANY (ARRAY['critical'::text, 'high'::text, 'medium'::text, 'low'::text])))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_source_check CHECK ((((finding_type ~~ 'pull.%'::text) = (source IS NOT NULL)) AND ((source IS NULL) OR (source = ANY (ARRAY['pull'::text, 'verification'::text])))))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['auto_fixed'::text, 'reconcile_required'::text, 'requires_review'::text, 'fixed'::text, 'ignored'::text])))
  constraint reconciliation_findings_type_check CHECK ((finding_type ~ '^(pull|derive|life|consistency|notify|catalog)\.[a-z0-9_]+(\.[a-z0-9_]+)?$'::text))
  index CREATE INDEX reconciliation_findings_approval_run_id_idx ON billing.reconciliation_findings USING btree (merchant_id, approval_run_id) WHERE (approval_run_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX reconciliation_findings_finding_type_idx ON billing.reconciliation_findings USING btree (finding_type) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['reconcile_required'::text, 'requires_review'::text]))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reconciliation_findings_finding_type_psp_id_subject_key_key ON billing.reconciliation_findings USING btree (merchant_id, finding_type, psp_id, subject_key) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
  index CREATE INDEX reconciliation_findings_first_seen_run_idx ON billing.reconciliation_findings USING btree (merchant_id, first_seen_run) WHERE (first_seen_run IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX reconciliation_findings_last_seen_run_idx ON billing.reconciliation_findings USING btree (merchant_id, last_seen_run) WHERE (last_seen_run IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX reconciliation_findings_open_catalog_idx ON billing.reconciliation_findings USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, openrails_resource_type, openrails_resource_id, rail) WHERE ((resolved_at IS NULL) AND (finding_type ~~ 'catalog.%'::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reconciliation_findings_pkey ON billing.reconciliation_findings USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX reconciliation_findings_proposals_idx ON billing.reconciliation_findings USING btree (merchant_id, status, source, psp_id) WHERE (finding_type ~~ 'pull.%'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX reconciliation_findings_resolved_idx ON billing.reconciliation_findings USING btree (merchant_id, GREATEST(resolved_at, last_seen_at)) WHERE (resolved_at IS NOT NULL)

table billing.reconciliation_state
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column source_domain text NOT NULL
  column fully_reconciled boolean NOT NULL
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint reconciliation_state_domain_check CHECK ((source_domain = ANY (ARRAY['subscriptions'::text, 'payments'::text, 'grants'::text])))
  constraint reconciliation_state_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint reconciliation_state_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, source_domain)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reconciliation_state_pkey ON billing.reconciliation_state USING btree (merchant_id, source_domain)

table billing.running_charges
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column reference text NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column rate_per_hour bigint NOT NULL
  column overdraft_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column resource text
  column started_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column stopped_at timestamp with time zone
  column posted_through_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column posted_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint running_charges_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint running_charges_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint running_charges_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint running_charges_overdraft_amount_check CHECK ((overdraft_amount >= 0))
  constraint running_charges_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint running_charges_posted_check CHECK (((posted_through_at >= started_at) AND (posted_amount = billing.running_charge_total(rate_per_hour, started_at, posted_through_at))))
  constraint running_charges_rate_per_hour_check CHECK (((rate_per_hour > 0) AND (rate_per_hour <= '1000000000000'::bigint)))
  constraint running_charges_reference_check CHECK (((reference <> ''::text) AND (reference = btrim(reference)) AND (octet_length(reference) <= 255)))
  constraint running_charges_reference_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, reference)
  constraint running_charges_resource_check CHECK (((resource <> ''::text) AND (octet_length(resource) <= 255)))
  constraint running_charges_stopped_at_check CHECK (((stopped_at IS NULL) OR (stopped_at = posted_through_at)))
  index CREATE INDEX running_charges_customer_id_currency_idx ON billing.running_charges USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency) WHERE (stopped_at IS NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX running_charges_pkey ON billing.running_charges USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX running_charges_reference_key ON billing.running_charges USING btree (merchant_id, reference)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_running_charge_facts BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON billing.running_charges FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_billing_fact_columns('stopped_at', 'posted_through_at', 'posted_amount', 'updated_at')

table billing.scheduled_changes
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column subscription_id uuid NOT NULL
  column from_price_id uuid NOT NULL
  column price_id uuid NOT NULL
  column quantity integer
  column effective_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column source text NOT NULL
  column price_migration_id uuid
  column status text NOT NULL
  column blocked_reason text
  column acknowledged_short_notice boolean NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column applied_at timestamp with time zone
  column canceled_at timestamp with time zone
  column invoker text
  column reason text
  constraint scheduled_changes_applied_check CHECK (((status = 'applied'::text) = (applied_at IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint scheduled_changes_blocked_check CHECK ((((status = 'blocked'::text) = (blocked_reason IS NOT NULL)) AND ((status <> 'blocked'::text) OR (source = 'migration'::text)) AND (blocked_reason <> ''::text)))
  constraint scheduled_changes_canceled_check CHECK (((status = 'canceled'::text) = (canceled_at IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint scheduled_changes_from_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, from_price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint scheduled_changes_invoker_check CHECK ((invoker <> ''::text))
  constraint scheduled_changes_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint scheduled_changes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint scheduled_changes_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint scheduled_changes_price_migration_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_migration_id) REFERENCES billing.price_migrations(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint scheduled_changes_quantity_check CHECK (((quantity IS NULL) OR (quantity >= 1)))
  constraint scheduled_changes_reason_check CHECK ((reason <> ''::text))
  constraint scheduled_changes_source_check CHECK (((source = ANY (ARRAY['change'::text, 'migration'::text])) AND ((source = 'migration'::text) = (price_migration_id IS NOT NULL))))
  constraint scheduled_changes_staff_check CHECK ((((invoker IS NULL) = (reason IS NULL)) AND ((invoker IS NULL) OR (source = 'change'::text))))
  constraint scheduled_changes_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['scheduled'::text, 'applied'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'blocked'::text])))
  constraint scheduled_changes_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  index CREATE INDEX scheduled_changes_from_price_id_idx ON billing.scheduled_changes USING btree (merchant_id, from_price_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scheduled_changes_pkey ON billing.scheduled_changes USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX scheduled_changes_price_id_idx ON billing.scheduled_changes USING btree (merchant_id, price_id)
  index CREATE INDEX scheduled_changes_price_migration_id_idx ON billing.scheduled_changes USING btree (merchant_id, price_migration_id) WHERE (price_migration_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX scheduled_changes_redrive_idx ON billing.scheduled_changes USING btree (merchant_id, created_at) WHERE ((status = 'blocked'::text) AND (blocked_reason ~~ 'rail_push_failed:%'::text))
  index CREATE INDEX scheduled_changes_subscription_id_idx ON billing.scheduled_changes USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scheduled_changes_subscription_id_key ON billing.scheduled_changes USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id) WHERE (status = 'scheduled'::text)

table billing.solana_crankers
  column name text NOT NULL
  column public_key text NOT NULL
  column pinned_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint solana_crankers_name_check CHECK ((btrim(name) <> ''::text))
  constraint solana_crankers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (name)
  constraint solana_crankers_public_key_check CHECK ((btrim(public_key) <> ''::text))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX solana_crankers_pkey ON billing.solana_crankers USING btree (name)

table billing.solana_pay_receipts
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column reference text NOT NULL
  column signature text NOT NULL
  column order_attempt_id uuid NOT NULL
  column disposition text NOT NULL
  column review_reason text
  column recipient text NOT NULL
  column token_mint text NOT NULL
  column expected_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column received_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column payer text
  column landed_at timestamp with time zone
  column payment_id uuid
  column resolved_at timestamp with time zone
  column resolution text
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint solana_pay_receipts_amounts_check CHECK (((expected_amount >= 0) AND (received_amount >= 0)))
  constraint solana_pay_receipts_disposition_check CHECK ((((disposition = 'credited'::text) AND (payment_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((review_reason IS NULL) OR (review_reason = 'overpaid'::text))) OR ((disposition = 'review'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (review_reason = ANY (ARRAY['already_paid'::text, 'late'::text, 'underpaid'::text, 'session_closed'::text, 'wrong_asset'::text, 'unreadable'::text, 'settle_failed'::text]))) OR ((disposition = 'duplicate'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (review_reason = 'claimed_elsewhere'::text)) OR ((disposition = 'ignored'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (review_reason IS NULL))))
  constraint solana_pay_receipts_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint solana_pay_receipts_order_attempt_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, order_attempt_id) REFERENCES billing.order_attempts(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint solana_pay_receipts_payment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, payment_id) REFERENCES billing.payments(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint solana_pay_receipts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, reference, signature)
  constraint solana_pay_receipts_resolution_check CHECK ((((resolved_at IS NULL) = (resolution IS NULL)) AND ((resolved_at IS NULL) OR (review_reason IS NOT NULL))))
  index CREATE INDEX solana_pay_receipts_created_at_idx ON billing.solana_pay_receipts USING btree (merchant_id, created_at) WHERE ((review_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (resolved_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX solana_pay_receipts_order_attempt_id_idx ON billing.solana_pay_receipts USING btree (merchant_id, order_attempt_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX solana_pay_receipts_pkey ON billing.solana_pay_receipts USING btree (merchant_id, reference, signature)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX solana_pay_receipts_signature_recipient_token_mint_key ON billing.solana_pay_receipts USING btree (signature, recipient, token_mint) WHERE (disposition = ANY (ARRAY['credited'::text, 'review'::text]))

table billing.solana_pay_references
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column reference text NOT NULL
  column order_attempt_id uuid NOT NULL
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column expires_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column watch_ends_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column next_poll_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column signature text
  column seen_until text
  column scan_stack text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::text[]
  column scan_below text
  column built_transaction text
  column built_valid_height bigint
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint solana_pay_references_built_check CHECK (((built_transaction IS NULL) = (built_valid_height IS NULL)))
  constraint solana_pay_references_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['purchase'::text, 'subscribe'::text])))
  constraint solana_pay_references_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint solana_pay_references_order_attempt_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, order_attempt_id) REFERENCES billing.order_attempts(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint solana_pay_references_order_attempt_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, order_attempt_id)
  constraint solana_pay_references_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, reference)
  constraint solana_pay_references_signature_check CHECK (((status = 'confirmed'::text) = (signature IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint solana_pay_references_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'expired'::text])))
  constraint solana_pay_references_window_check CHECK ((watch_ends_at >= expires_at))
  index CREATE INDEX solana_pay_references_next_poll_at_idx ON billing.solana_pay_references USING btree (next_poll_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX solana_pay_references_order_attempt_id_key ON billing.solana_pay_references USING btree (merchant_id, order_attempt_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX solana_pay_references_pkey ON billing.solana_pay_references USING btree (merchant_id, reference)
  index CREATE INDEX solana_pay_references_watch_ends_at_idx ON billing.solana_pay_references USING btree (watch_ends_at) WHERE (status <> 'pending'::text)

table billing.solana_subscriptions
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid NOT NULL
  column subscriber_wallet text NOT NULL
  column authority_pda text NOT NULL
  column subscription_pda text NOT NULL
  column plan_pda text NOT NULL
  column merchant_address text NOT NULL
  column mint text NOT NULL
  column plan_created_at_fingerprint bigint NOT NULL
  column last_pulled_period_starts_at timestamp with time zone
  column last_signature text
  column next_pull_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column treasury text NOT NULL
  constraint solana_subscriptions_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint solana_subscriptions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint solana_subscriptions_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'expired'::text])))
  constraint solana_subscriptions_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint solana_subscriptions_subscription_pda_key UNIQUE (subscription_pda)
  index CREATE INDEX solana_subscriptions_next_pull_at_idx ON billing.solana_subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, next_pull_at) WHERE (status = 'active'::text)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX solana_subscriptions_pkey ON billing.solana_subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX solana_subscriptions_subscription_id_idx ON billing.solana_subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX solana_subscriptions_subscription_pda_key ON billing.solana_subscriptions USING btree (subscription_pda)

table billing.subscription_billing_changes
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column subscription_id uuid NOT NULL
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column kind text NOT NULL
  column decision text
  column from_payment_method_id uuid
  column to_payment_method_id uuid
  column from_next_retry_at timestamp with time zone
  column to_next_retry_at timestamp with time zone
  column from_last_retry_at timestamp with time zone
  column to_last_retry_at timestamp with time zone
  column from_retry_attempts integer
  column to_retry_attempts integer
  column from_transient_retries integer
  column to_transient_retries integer
  column from_grace_ends_at timestamp with time zone
  column to_grace_ends_at timestamp with time zone
  column method_version_id uuid
  column origin text
  column actor text
  column executor text
  column operation_id uuid
  constraint subscription_billing_changes_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['card_selection'::text, 'default_card'::text, 'card_version'::text, 'retry_schedule'::text])))
  constraint subscription_billing_changes_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint subscription_billing_changes_merchant_id_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint subscription_billing_changes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX subscription_billing_changes_history_idx ON billing.subscription_billing_changes USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subscription_billing_changes_pkey ON billing.subscription_billing_changes USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX subscription_billing_changes_retention_idx ON billing.subscription_billing_changes USING btree (merchant_id, occurred_at)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_subscription_billing_changes BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.subscription_billing_changes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER retained_subscription_billing_changes BEFORE DELETE ON billing.subscription_billing_changes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_retention_delete('occurred_at', '761 days')

table billing.subscription_status_transitions
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid NOT NULL
  column from_status text
  column to_status text NOT NULL
  column cancel_type text
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column decision text
  column from_current_period_ends_at timestamp with time zone
  column to_current_period_ends_at timestamp with time zone
  column origin text
  column actor text
  column executor text
  column operation_id uuid
  constraint subscription_status_transitions_cancel_type_check CHECK ((cancel_type = ANY (ARRAY['user'::text, 'merchant'::text, 'expired'::text, 'chargeback'::text, 'upgrade'::text])))
  constraint subscription_status_transitions_from_status_check CHECK ((from_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'active'::text, 'past_due'::text, 'awaiting_method'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'unverified'::text])))
  constraint subscription_status_transitions_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint subscription_status_transitions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint subscription_status_transitions_real_transition_check CHECK (((from_status IS DISTINCT FROM to_status) OR (from_current_period_ends_at IS DISTINCT FROM to_current_period_ends_at)))
  constraint subscription_status_transitions_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint subscription_status_transitions_to_status_check CHECK ((to_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'active'::text, 'past_due'::text, 'awaiting_method'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'unverified'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX subscription_status_transitions_occurred_at_idx ON billing.subscription_status_transitions USING btree (merchant_id, occurred_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subscription_status_transitions_pkey ON billing.subscription_status_transitions USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX subscription_status_transitions_subscription_id_occurred_at_idx ON billing.subscription_status_transitions USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id, occurred_at)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER immutable_subscription_status_transitions BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.subscription_status_transitions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.reject_immutable_billing_fact()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER retained_subscription_status_transitions BEFORE DELETE ON billing.subscription_status_transitions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.guard_retention_delete('occurred_at', '761 days')

table billing.subscription_verifications
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column subscription_id uuid NOT NULL
  column unverified_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column reads integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column last_read_at timestamp with time zone
  column last_error text
  constraint subscription_verifications_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id)
  constraint subscription_verifications_subscription_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, subscription_id) REFERENCES billing.subscriptions(merchant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subscription_verifications_pkey ON billing.subscription_verifications USING btree (merchant_id, subscription_id)
  index CREATE INDEX subscription_verifications_unverified_at_idx ON billing.subscription_verifications USING btree (merchant_id, unverified_at)

table billing.subscriptions
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column price_id uuid
  column product_id uuid NOT NULL
  column status text NOT NULL
  column rail text NOT NULL
  column collection_policy text NOT NULL
  column rail_subscription_id text
  column payment_method_id uuid
  column current_period_starts_at timestamp with time zone
  column current_period_ends_at timestamp with time zone
  column started_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column ended_at timestamp with time zone
  column grace_ends_at timestamp with time zone
  column last_retry_at timestamp with time zone
  column retry_attempts integer DEFAULT 0
  column next_retry_at timestamp with time zone
  column canceled_at timestamp with time zone
  column cancel_type text
  column cancel_feedback text
  column gateway_response jsonb
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column tier_group text
  column deletion_scheduled_at timestamp with time zone
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column psp_id uuid NOT NULL
  column deleted_at timestamp with time zone
  column destructive_run_id uuid
  column destructive_run_class text GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'destructive'::text ELSE NULL::text END) STORED
  column transient_retries integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column lifecycle_rev bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column row_version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column dunning_policy jsonb
  column access_duration_hours_snapshot integer
  column quantity integer
  column provider_access_default_snapshot boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  constraint subscriptions_access_duration_hours_snapshot_check CHECK (((access_duration_hours_snapshot IS NULL) OR (access_duration_hours_snapshot > 0)))
  constraint subscriptions_cancel_type_check CHECK ((cancel_type = ANY (ARRAY['user'::text, 'merchant'::text, 'expired'::text, 'chargeback'::text, 'upgrade'::text])))
  constraint subscriptions_canceled_has_timestamp_check CHECK (((status <> 'canceled'::text) OR (canceled_at IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint subscriptions_canceled_has_type_check CHECK (((status <> 'canceled'::text) OR (cancel_type IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint subscriptions_canceled_no_retry_schedule_check CHECK (((status <> 'canceled'::text) OR ((next_retry_at IS NULL) AND (grace_ends_at IS NULL))))
  constraint subscriptions_collection_policy_check CHECK ((collection_policy = ANY (ARRAY['provider'::text, 'nmi_schedule'::text, 'engine'::text])))
  constraint subscriptions_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint subscriptions_customer_id_id_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  constraint subscriptions_customer_id_payment_method_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, payment_method_id) REFERENCES billing.payment_methods(merchant_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (payment_method_id)
  constraint subscriptions_destructive_run_id_destructive_run_class_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, destructive_run_id, destructive_run_class) REFERENCES billing.maintenance_runs(merchant_id, id, run_class) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint subscriptions_ended_not_before_canceled_check CHECK (((ended_at IS NULL) OR (canceled_at IS NULL) OR (ended_at >= canceled_at)))
  constraint subscriptions_engine_binding_check CHECK (((collection_policy <> 'engine'::text) OR (((rail = ANY (ARRAY['nmi'::text, 'stripe'::text])) AND (rail_subscription_id IS NULL)) OR (rail = 'solana'::text))))
  constraint subscriptions_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint subscriptions_nmi_schedule_rail_check CHECK (((collection_policy = 'nmi_schedule'::text) = ((rail = 'nmi'::text) AND (collection_policy <> 'engine'::text))))
  constraint subscriptions_past_due_has_period_end_check CHECK (((status <> 'past_due'::text) OR (current_period_ends_at IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint subscriptions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id)
  constraint subscriptions_price_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id)
  constraint subscriptions_price_id_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, price_id, product_id) REFERENCES billing.prices(merchant_id, id, product_id)
  constraint subscriptions_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, product_id) REFERENCES billing.products(merchant_id, id)
  constraint subscriptions_provider_access_choice_check CHECK (((NOT provider_access_default_snapshot) OR (access_duration_hours_snapshot IS NULL)))
  constraint subscriptions_psp_id_rail_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, psp_id, rail) REFERENCES billing.psps(merchant_id, id, rail) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint subscriptions_quantity_check CHECK (((quantity IS NULL) OR ((quantity >= 1) AND (collection_policy = 'engine'::text) AND (rail = ANY (ARRAY['nmi'::text, 'stripe'::text])))))
  constraint subscriptions_rail_subscription_id_check CHECK ((rail_subscription_id <> ''::text))
  constraint subscriptions_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'active'::text, 'past_due'::text, 'awaiting_method'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'unverified'::text])))
  constraint subscriptions_stop_pending_canceled_check CHECK (((status = 'canceled'::text) OR (deletion_scheduled_at IS NULL)))
  constraint subscriptions_transient_retries_check CHECK ((transient_retries >= 0))
  constraint subscriptions_valid_period_check CHECK (((current_period_starts_at IS NULL) OR (current_period_ends_at IS NULL) OR (current_period_starts_at < current_period_ends_at)))
  constraint trg_subscriptions_track_unverified TRIGGER DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_canceled_at_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, canceled_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (canceled_at IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_canceled_at_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, canceled_at) WHERE (canceled_at IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_created_at_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_current_period_ends_at_engine_due_global_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (current_period_ends_at, merchant_id) WHERE ((collection_policy = 'engine'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'past_due'::text])) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_current_period_ends_at_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, current_period_ends_at, id) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (current_period_ends_at IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_current_period_ends_at_next_retry_at_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, current_period_ends_at, next_retry_at) WHERE ((collection_policy = 'engine'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'past_due'::text])) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_current_period_ends_at_period_overdue_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (current_period_ends_at) WHERE (status = 'active'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_current_period_ends_at_rebill_watch_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, current_period_ends_at) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'unverified'::text, 'awaiting_method'::text])) AND (collection_policy = ANY (ARRAY['engine'::text, 'nmi_schedule'::text])) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_customer_id_created_at_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subscriptions_customer_id_id_key ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subscriptions_customer_id_product_id_key ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, product_id) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending'::text, 'past_due'::text, 'awaiting_method'::text, 'unverified'::text])) OR (deletion_scheduled_at IS NOT NULL)))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subscriptions_customer_id_tier_group_key ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, tier_group) WHERE ((tier_group IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending'::text, 'past_due'::text, 'awaiting_method'::text, 'unverified'::text])) OR (deletion_scheduled_at IS NOT NULL)))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_destructive_run_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, destructive_run_id) WHERE (destructive_run_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_destructive_scale_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, price_id) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'past_due'::text])) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_ended_at_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, ended_at) WHERE (ended_at IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_gateway_order_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, rail, ((gateway_response ->> 'order_id'::text))) WHERE ((gateway_response ->> 'order_id'::text) IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_grace_ends_at_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (grace_ends_at) WHERE (grace_ends_at IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_next_retry_at_rail_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (next_retry_at, rail) WHERE ((status = 'past_due'::text) AND (next_retry_at IS NOT NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_payment_method_id_current_period_ends_at_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, payment_method_id, current_period_ends_at) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (payment_method_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'past_due'::text, 'awaiting_method'::text])))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_payment_method_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, payment_method_id) WHERE (payment_method_id IS NOT NULL)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subscriptions_pkey ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, id)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_price_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, price_id)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_product_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, product_id)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_psp_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subscriptions_psp_id_rail_subscription_id_key ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, psp_id, rail_subscription_id) WHERE ((rail_subscription_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_rail_rail_subscription_id_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (rail, rail_subscription_id)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_started_at_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (merchant_id, started_at)
  index CREATE INDEX subscriptions_status_idx ON billing.subscriptions USING btree (status)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER subscriptions_collection_policy_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF collection_policy ON billing.subscriptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.preserve_subscription_collection_policy()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER subscriptions_lifecycle_single_writer BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.subscriptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.subscriptions_lifecycle_single_writer()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER subscriptions_release_ownership_claims AFTER UPDATE OF status, deleted_at ON billing.subscriptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.release_ended_ownership_claims()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER subscriptions_row_version BEFORE UPDATE ON billing.subscriptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.subscriptions_row_version()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER subscriptions_void_renewal_orders AFTER UPDATE OF status, deleted_at ON billing.subscriptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.void_ended_renewal_orders()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER trg_subscriptions_billing_changes AFTER UPDATE OF payment_method_id, next_retry_at, last_retry_at, retry_attempts, transient_retries, grace_ends_at ON billing.subscriptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.subscriptions_record_billing_change()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER trg_subscriptions_set_tier_group BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF product_id, tier_group, status, deleted_at ON billing.subscriptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.subscriptions_set_tier_group()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER trg_subscriptions_status_transition AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status, current_period_ends_at ON billing.subscriptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.subscriptions_record_status_transition()
  trigger CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER trg_subscriptions_track_unverified AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON billing.subscriptions DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing.subscriptions_track_unverified()

table billing.usage_collection_cadence
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column monthly_period_started_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column completed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  constraint invoice_collection_cadence_check CHECK ((completed_at >= monthly_period_started_at))
  constraint invoice_collection_cadence_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint invoice_collection_cadence_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invoice_collection_cadence_pkey ON billing.usage_collection_cadence USING btree (merchant_id)

table billing.usage_events PARTITION BY RANGE (occurred_at)
  column id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
  column merchant_id uuid NOT NULL
  column customer_id uuid NOT NULL
  column invoker_id text NOT NULL
  column currency text NOT NULL
  column resource text
  column event_type text NOT NULL
  column dimensions jsonb NOT NULL
  column amount bigint NOT NULL
  column source text NOT NULL
  column source_id text NOT NULL
  column ledger_transfer_id uuid
  column metadata jsonb
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column outcome text NOT NULL
  column forgiven_amount bigint NOT NULL
  column charges jsonb NOT NULL
  column stated_amount bigint
  constraint usage_events_amount_check CHECK ((amount >= 0))
  constraint usage_events_charges_check CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(charges) = 'array'::text))
  constraint usage_events_currency_check CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$'::text))
  constraint usage_events_customer_id_currency_ledger_transfer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, ledger_transfer_id) REFERENCES billing.ledger_transfers(merchant_id, customer_id, currency, id)
  constraint usage_events_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id, customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers(merchant_id, id)
  constraint usage_events_failed_stated_amount_check CHECK (((outcome = 'succeeded'::text) OR (stated_amount IS NOT NULL))) NOT VALID
  constraint usage_events_forgiven_amount_check CHECK (((forgiven_amount >= 0) AND ((outcome = 'failed'::text) OR (forgiven_amount = 0))))
  constraint usage_events_merchant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES billing.merchants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint usage_events_outcome_check CHECK ((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text])))
  constraint usage_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (merchant_id, id, occurred_at)
  constraint usage_events_source_id_check CHECK (((octet_length(source_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(source_id) <= 255)))
  constraint usage_events_stated_amount_check CHECK ((stated_amount >= 0))
  index CREATE INDEX usage_events_customer_id_occurred_at_idx ON ONLY billing.usage_events USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, occurred_at)
  index CREATE INDEX usage_events_event_type_occurred_at_idx ON ONLY billing.usage_events USING btree (merchant_id, event_type, occurred_at)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX usage_events_idem_key ON ONLY billing.usage_events USING btree (merchant_id, customer_id, currency, event_type, source, source_id, occurred_at)
